abilities.name: Mana Break
abilities.desc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
notes: Mana Break has 25% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.
abilities.lore: A modified technique of the Turstarkuri monks' peaceful ways is to turn magical energies on their owner.
abilities.scepter: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
notes: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
abilities.lore: In his encounter with the Dead Gods, Anti-Mage learned the value of being elusive.
abilities.scepter: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within 5s burns an additional 20% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.

abilities.name: Counterspell
abilities.desc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
notes: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
abilities.lore: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.
abilities.shard: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.

abilities.name: Persecutor
abilities.desc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 60% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 60% mana.
notes: Full effect if caused by illusions.

abilities.name: Mana Void
abilities.desc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies. The main target is also mini-stunned.
notes: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
abilities.lore: After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.

abilities.name: Berserker's Call
abilities.desc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
abilities.lore: Mogul Khan's warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.
abilities.shard: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.

abilities.name: Battle Hunger
abilities.desc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
notes: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.
abilities.lore: Ordinary heroes cannot withstand Mogul Khan's rage for battle, such that it injures them until it is satisfied.
abilities.shard: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.

abilities.name: Counter Helix
abilities.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
notes: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
abilities.lore: Axe is the only reinforcement this army needs.
abilities.scepter: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

abilities.name: Culling Blade
abilities.desc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
notes: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.
abilities.lore: Mogul Khan is the embodiment of battle and fury, launching into a gruesome fatality against those who dare engage the Axe in combat.

abilities.name: One Man Army
abilities.desc: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe. The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

options: +3s Culling Blade Kill Buff Bonus Duration
+8% Movement Speed per active Battle Hunger

abilities.name: Enfeeble
abilities.desc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
abilities.lore: Each tendril of fear that Atropos weaves increases the vulnerability of his victims to arcane and unknown arts.

abilities.name: Brain Sap
abilities.desc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
abilities.lore: Atropos finds no greater pleasure than to harvest the fear he creates.
abilities.shard: Reduces cooldown by . Causes Brain Sap to become a 550 AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for 30%.

abilities.name: Nightmare
abilities.desc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
notes: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
abilities.lore: A stolen prowess from the goddess Nyctasha is to put his prey into forever sleep.

abilities.name: Fiend's Grip
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
abilities.lore: Victims of Atropos are frequently torn apart by vivid conjurations of their own nightmares.
abilities.scepter: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take 225% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

abilities.name: Ichor of Nyctasha
abilities.desc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

abilities.name: Bloodrage
abilities.desc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
notes: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.
abilities.lore: Strygwyr shares his animalistic thirst for bloodshed.
abilities.shard: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal 1.5% of the target's max health as Pure damage.

abilities.name: Blood Rite
abilities.desc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After 2.9 seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
notes: Total time is a 2.6 second delay plus a 0.3 second cast time.
abilities.lore: The Flayed Twins are ever willing to aid those who spill blood upon the field of battle.

abilities.name: Thirst
abilities.desc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
notes: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below 25%.
Effects linger for 4 seconds if a target dies.
abilities.lore: Strygwyr becomes frenzied when blood is spilled.

abilities.name: Sanguivore
abilities.desc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to 30 health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
notes: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by 40%.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.desc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
abilities.lore: When the Bloodseeker hunts you, injuries become fatalities.
abilities.scepter: Increases initial damage and grants 2 Rupture Charges.

abilities.name: Crystal Nova
abilities.desc: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
notes: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.
abilities.lore: The air temperature around Rylai drops rapidly, chilling all around her to the core.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.desc: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.
notes: Frostbite is considered a root.
abilities.lore: Rylai channels winds from the Blueheart Glacier, imprisoning attackers in thick blocks of ice.

abilities.name: Arcane Aura
abilities.desc:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
abilities.lore: Cold temperatures promote the essence of magic, causing Rylai's presence to allow spell usage in abundance.

abilities.name: Crystal Clone
abilities.desc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
abilities.lore: So convincing that some allies have spent minutes talking to the clone before they realized she wasn't speaking back.

abilities.name: Glacial Guard
abilities.desc: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

abilities.name: Freezing Field
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.
notes: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts 1 second).
Explosions occur every 0.1 seconds.
abilities.lore: Once the place of her exile, Icewrack has become an anchor for Rylai's frigid onslaught.
abilities.scepter: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move 75% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by 20%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over 3s.

options: +20% Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier

abilities.name: Frost Arrows
abilities.desc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage. Slow lasts 1.5 seconds.
notes: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.
abilities.lore: Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.
abilities.scepter: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.desc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.
abilities.lore: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

abilities.name: Multishot
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + 475. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
notes: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.
abilities.lore: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.

abilities.name: Glacier
abilities.desc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
abilities.lore: Traxex wasn't just adopted by the Drow, she was adopted by the lands they lived in.

abilities.name: Precision Aura
abilities.desc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received 50% of the bonus agility.
abilities.lore: Traxex' time spent alone in the forests of her Drow home has allowed her to teach other archers how to improve their bow skills.

abilities.name: Marksmanship
abilities.desc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within 300 range.
notes: Marksmanship procs have true strike.
abilities.lore: The Drow Ranger is the epitome of archery prowess.

abilities.name: Fissure
abilities.desc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
notes: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
abilities.lore: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.
abilities.shard: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.

abilities.name: Enchant Totem
abilities.desc: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.
notes: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.
abilities.lore: Raigor's gorilla strength can destroy mountains.
abilities.scepter: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there. Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.

abilities.name: Aftershock
abilities.desc: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
notes: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.
abilities.lore: The earth trembles beneath the mighty footsteps of Raigor.

abilities.name: Echo Slam
abilities.desc: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units. Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
abilities.lore: Tectonic plates crack, mountains fold, and foes are crushed by the Echo Slam.

abilities.name: Slugger
abilities.desc: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

values.label: FLYING ENEMY'S MAX HEALTH AS DAMAGE

abilities.name: Blade Fury
abilities.desc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
notes: You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.
abilities.lore: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.
abilities.scepter:
Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect.

 Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every s.

abilities.name: Healing Ward
abilities.desc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 / 20 / 22 / 24 seconds.
notes: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.
abilities.lore: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.
abilities.shard: Increases ward healing and health.

abilities.name: Blade Dance
abilities.desc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
abilities.lore: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.

abilities.name: Swiftslash
abilities.desc: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.
abilities.lore: A briefer onslaught for those less deserving of the honor.

abilities.name: Bladeform
abilities.desc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Omnislash
abilities.desc:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: You can use items during Omnislash.
abilities.lore: 'The fruits of discipline; with practice comes strength.'

abilities.name: Starstorm
abilities.desc: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a 675 radius will be struck a second time.
notes: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.
abilities.lore: The Goddess breaks the strata to empower her Princess in the time of need.

abilities.name: Sacred Arrow
abilities.desc: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.3 / 3.2 / 4.1 / 5 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
notes: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
abilities.lore: Lunar energies make the Princess of the Moon's arrows more deadly than most.
abilities.scepter: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.desc: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts 5 seconds.
abilities.lore: None can fail to recognize Mirana's iconic white beast in the heat of battle.
abilities.shard: Grants +1 Leap charge.

abilities.name: Celestial Quiver
abilities.desc: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.
abilities.shard: Grants 3 temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.

abilities.name: Moonlight Shadow
abilities.desc: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
notes: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.
abilities.lore: Her tenure with Selemene allows Mirana to eclipse the ground, wrapping her allies in a cloak of shadows.

abilities.name: Shadowraze
abilities.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
notes: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
abilities.lore: Nevermore's trademark for harvesting souls.
abilities.shard: Cooldown reduced by 2s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking 12% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.

abilities.name: Feast of Souls
abilities.desc:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for 8 seconds. For the duration of the effect, every 0.5s he collects souls from 2 enemies in a 600 radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for 8s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
abilities.lore: For Nevermore, there's as much delight in the harvest as there is in the feast.

abilities.name: Presence of the Dark Lord
abilities.desc: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
notes: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.
abilities.lore: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one's soul.

abilities.name: Requiem of Souls
abilities.desc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for 0.6 seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of 2.15. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
notes: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every 1 soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
abilities.lore: The captured souls of those past slain are released to ravage their former allies.
abilities.scepter: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

abilities.name: Necromastery
abilities.desc: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining 1 bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant 4 souls. On death, he releases 30% of them from bondage.
notes: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
abilities.lore: Harvested souls swirl in and out of the Abysm, empowering the Shadow Fiend to increase the size of his collection.
abilities.scepter: Increases max souls.

options: +2 Feast of Souls Souls Collected Per Hero
Feast of Souls Grants +30% Cast Speed

abilities.name: Waveform
abilities.desc: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
abilities.lore: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.

abilities.name: Adaptive Strike
abilities.desc:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier. If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
notes: Projectile moves at 1150 speed.
abilities.lore: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.

abilities.name: Attribute Shift (Agility Gain)
abilities.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of 4 / 8 / 12 / 16. The process is reversible.
notes: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.
abilities.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
abilities.shard: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

abilities.name: Attribute Shift (Strength Gain)
abilities.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of 4 / 8 / 12 / 16. The process is reversible.
notes: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.
abilities.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
abilities.shard: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

abilities.name: Morph
abilities.desc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
notes: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
abilities.lore: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.
abilities.scepter: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.

abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
abilities.desc: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
notes: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

abilities.name: Spirit Lance
abilities.desc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
notes: Illusions within 675 range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
abilities.lore: Azwraith's proficiency at spearing his family's meal of fish is proving quite useful in the battlefield.
abilities.scepter: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.

abilities.name: Doppelganger
abilities.desc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After 1 second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes 500% bonus damage and deals -80% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
abilities.lore: Dread Magus Vorn's death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to bend and fracture all spectrums of light.

abilities.name: Phantom Rush
abilities.desc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
notes: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is 800.
abilities.lore: Azwraith knows that on the field of battle, speed can mean everything.
abilities.scepter: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every 600 units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.

abilities.name: Illusory Armaments
abilities.desc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Juxtapose
abilities.desc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
abilities.lore: Each of Azwraith's lance attacks feels like two from a normal warrior; or three; or four...
abilities.shard: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to 8 seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by 15% during this invisibility.

abilities.name: Illusory Orb
abilities.desc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional 3% of its impact damage every 0.5s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

 Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
notes: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.
abilities.lore: The playful Faerie Dragon delights in confusing others, vanishing and reappearing where unexpected.

abilities.name: Waning Rift
abilities.desc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
abilities.lore: With a mischievous grin, Puck spreads its enchanted powder which disrupts magical flow.

abilities.name: Phase Shift
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
notes: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
abilities.lore: With a quip and flash, Puck returns to the alien dimension from whence it came.
abilities.shard: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.

abilities.name: Puckish
abilities.desc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores 3% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores 3x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

abilities.name: Dream Coil
abilities.desc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them. If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
abilities.lore: The Faerie Dragon sows confusion by forcing its enemies to vividly dream about their own mortality.
abilities.scepter: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to 90% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.

abilities.name: Meat Hook
abilities.desc: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
notes: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
abilities.lore: The Butcher's hook is a symbolic nightmare, its curved blade a frightening reminder of his slaughterous intent.
abilities.shard:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by 50%.

abilities.name: Rot
abilities.desc: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
notes: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
abilities.lore: A foul odor precedes a toxic, choking gas, emanating from the Butcher's putrid, ever-swelling mass.
abilities.scepter: Increases Rot radius by , damage by , and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.

abilities.name: Meat Shield
abilities.desc: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.
abilities.lore: The Butcher gives new meaning to the words 'meat shield.'

abilities.name: Flesh Heap
abilities.desc: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 2 bonus Strength for each stack.
notes: Enemy Heroes that die within 450 of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.

abilities.name: Dismember
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of 75 units, up to a minimum of 125 range.
notes: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
abilities.lore: 'When I'm through with these vermin, they'll be fit for a pie!'

options: 1.5x Flesh Heap and Meat Shield bonuses

abilities.name: Plasma Field
abilities.desc: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
abilities.lore: The Lightning Revenant rules the Underscape with plasmatic power.

abilities.name: Static Link
abilities.desc: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
notes: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes 250 units greater than Static Link's cast range.
abilities.lore: Razor's polarity channels electricity into his being, draining the power of his opposition.
abilities.shard: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.

abilities.name: Storm Surge
abilities.desc: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: Merely approaching the Lightning Revenant is rewarded with shock therapy.
abilities.shard: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is 2x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by 2s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.

abilities.name: Unstable Current
abilities.desc: Passively increases Razor's movement speed.

abilities.name: Eye of the Storm
abilities.desc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
notes: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.
abilities.lore: Ride the lightning.
abilities.scepter: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.

options: -0.1s Eye of the Storm Strike Interval
Creates A Second Plasma Field Delayed By 0.8s

abilities.name: Burrowstrike
abilities.desc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

 Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
abilities.lore: Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.

abilities.name: Sand Storm
abilities.desc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
notes: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in 0.7 seconds.
abilities.lore: Some say Crixalis is a mirage; his carapace appearing then vanishing between the whirling sands of the Scintillant Waste.

abilities.name: Stinger
abilities.desc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
abilities.lore: Crixalis is certainly capable of mercy, but the soul of the sand finds few foes worth sparing.
abilities.shard: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals % damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.

abilities.name: Caustic Finale
abilities.desc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.
abilities.lore: An injection from Crixalis makes one brittle and as dry as the arid wastes, subject to implosive demise.

abilities.name: Epicenter
abilities.desc: After a cast point of 2 seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
notes: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.
abilities.lore: Many an explorer was lost to the quicksands of the Scintillant Waste.
abilities.scepter: When the pulses start, 3 Stinger attack areas are created every 0.5s at random locations, each measuring 35% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply 40% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause 1 attack(s).
abilities.shard: Every 3s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.

abilities.name: Static Remnant
abilities.desc: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for 12 seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
notes: Remnants take 0.75 second to materialize after the spell is cast.
Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
The explosion actually hits units in a 300 radius, but will only be triggered in 235.
Can be self-cast to cast in place.
abilities.lore: Raijin Thunderkeg's duality allows him to admire himself in shocking fashion.

abilities.name: Electric Vortex
abilities.desc: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
abilities.lore: Raijin's thunderous, boisterous energy often draws others into an electrifying situation.
abilities.scepter: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.desc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
notes: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.
abilities.lore: Pow! Zip! Zap!
abilities.shard: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes 3 Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to 12 seconds or until the charges are depleted.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.desc: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is 25+7.5% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is 10+0.65% of his total mana pool. Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
notes: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.
abilities.lore: The Storm is coming in.

abilities.name: Galvanized
abilities.desc: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every 3 levels. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.

options: 450 Distance Auto Remnant in Ball Lightning

abilities.name: Storm Hammer
abilities.desc: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
abilities.lore: The Rogue Knight's iron gauntlet, taken from the school of his father, strikes his foes to their core.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

abilities.name: Great Cleave
abilities.desc: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.
abilities.lore: The Vigil Knights still seek to reclaim the stolen Outcast Blade from Sven, a weapon capable of cutting wide swaths through lesser warriors.

abilities.name: Warcry
abilities.desc: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 8 seconds.
abilities.lore: Calling a few lines from the Vigil Codex fortifies Sven's obedience to his rogue code. So poetic!
abilities.shard: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a 300 physical damage barrier.

abilities.name: God's Strength
abilities.desc: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for 30 seconds.
notes: The bonus damage is based on base damage and the primary attribute of Sven.
abilities.lore: With the strength that shattered the Sacred Helm, the Rogue Knight stands unopposed in melee combat.

abilities.name: Wrath of God
abilities.desc: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

options: -25% Storm Hammer Cooldown and Mana Cost

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.desc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
abilities.lore: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.

abilities.name: Toss
abilities.desc: Grabs the nearest unit in a 300 radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
notes: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
Flight time is 1.1s.
abilities.lore: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.

abilities.name: Tree Grab
abilities.desc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks. The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
notes: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.
abilities.lore: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.

abilities.name: Tree Volley
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
abilities.lore: Sticks thrown from stones are like to shatter many bones.

abilities.name: Insurmountable
abilities.desc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

abilities.name: Grow
abilities.desc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
abilities.lore: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.
abilities.shard: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

abilities.name: Tree Throw
abilities.desc: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.
abilities.lore: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.

abilities.name: Magic Missile
abilities.desc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
abilities.lore: A simple Skywrath technique, the magic missile is Shendel's primary tool for vengeance.
abilities.shard: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within 75% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.

abilities.name: Wave of Terror
abilities.desc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
abilities.lore: Shendel's haunting voice hints at her approaching vindication.

abilities.name: Vengeance Aura
abilities.desc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives 25% extra bonus.
notes: Break disables the damage aura.
abilities.lore: Although they may not share her undying passion for revenge, allies do draw on her fanaticism in combat.
abilities.scepter:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.desc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals 20% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

abilities.name: Nether Swap
abilities.desc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
notes: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.
abilities.lore: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.

options: Wave Of Terror Steals 25% Of Reduced Damage And Armor

abilities.name: Shackleshot
abilities.desc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it. If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to 0.6.
notes: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most 575 behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.
abilities.lore: Windranger's variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.

abilities.name: Powershot
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to 1 second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
notes: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
abilities.lore: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.

abilities.name: Windrun
abilities.desc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
abilities.lore: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to fight incoming attacks.

abilities.name: Gale Force
abilities.desc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
abilities.lore: At last Lyralei has learned to call upon the might of her true birthright.

abilities.name: Focus Fire
abilities.desc: Windranger channels the wind to gain 350 / 425 / 500 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage. Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
notes: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.
abilities.lore: Lyralei's ability to bombard opponents with a flurry of arrows is unparalleled - even at the expense of accuracy.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.desc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
abilities.scepter: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.

options: Powershot Executes Enemy Heroes Under 16% Max HP
Focus Fire Kills Advance Cooldown by 16s

abilities.name: Arc Lightning
abilities.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
abilities.lore: Arc Lightning is Zeus' favorite spell to use against puny mortals.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.desc: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 600 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 325 range.
notes: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.
abilities.lore: A shocking punishment for rebellious heathen.

abilities.name: Heavenly Jump
abilities.desc: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.
abilities.lore: Though temporarily barred from the heavens, Zeus can still manage a measure of godly flight.

abilities.name: Nimbus
abilities.desc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
notes: Grants 125 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.
abilities.lore: Where the thunder god's ire grows, storm clouds quickly gather.

abilities.name: Lightning Hands
abilities.desc: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
abilities.lore: A helping hand from Aghanim lets the fallen Lord of Heaven tap into some of his old strengths.

abilities.name: Thundergod's Wrath
abilities.desc: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
abilities.lore: The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.

abilities.name: Static Field
abilities.desc: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
abilities.lore: The air crackles with static when the Thundergod walks the world.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.desc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.
abilities.lore: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.

abilities.name: Tidebringer
abilities.desc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
abilities.lore: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.

abilities.name: X Marks the Spot
abilities.desc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds. Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
abilities.lore: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.

abilities.name: Admiral's Rum
abilities.desc: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below 65% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to 18% of incoming damage for 5s.
notes: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.
abilities.lore: Deleterious to landlubbers, no one holds their rum like a sailor.

abilities.name: Tidal Wave
abilities.desc: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.
abilities.lore: A good sailor knows the timing of the tides like the back of his hand.

abilities.name: Ghostship
abilities.desc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a 2x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
notes: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of 650.
abilities.lore: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.
abilities.scepter: Ghostship creates a fleet of 2 ships at the target point on a 2.5 second interval. Each ship now also fires 3 waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal 40% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.

abilities.name: Dragon Slave
abilities.desc: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
notes: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
abilities.lore: In the scorched barren of Misrule, Lina learned to manipulate the fiery breath of the Desert Wyrm as a form of entertainment.

abilities.name: Light Strike Array
abilities.desc: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
notes: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.
abilities.lore: Lina's essence allows her to focus the sun's energies, causing air to combust at will.

abilities.name: Fiery Soul
abilities.desc: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 16 seconds.
notes: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.
abilities.lore: Dancing flames embody Lina's playful nature, bringing out her true blazing self.

abilities.name: Flame Cloak
abilities.desc: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
abilities.lore: A natural defense equally suited to keeping anything from unwanted sisters to snarling hellbeasts at bay.

abilities.name: Slow Burn
abilities.desc: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.

abilities.name: Laguna Blade
abilities.desc: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
notes: Laguna Blade has a 0.25 delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
abilities.lore: The air around Lina becomes so intensely torrid that it scorches a foe that comes too close with white-hot lightning.
abilities.shard: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

options: 5% Fiery Soul Magic Resist Per Stack
150% Attack Crit On Targets Affected By Slow Burn

abilities.name: Frost Blast
abilities.desc: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for 4 seconds. The primary target receives both base and area damage.
abilities.lore: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.

abilities.name: Frost Shield
abilities.desc: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
notes: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
abilities.lore: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.

abilities.name: Sinister Gaze
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
abilities.lore: Mind the cold...
abilities.scepter: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

abilities.name: Ice Spire
abilities.desc:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take 4 hero hits or 8 creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.
abilities.lore: The waters within the Black Pool remain liquid far below the point of freezing and immediately crystallize when removed.

abilities.name: Sacrifice
abilities.desc:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

abilities.name: Chain Frost
abilities.desc: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to 10 times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
notes: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of 850.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
abilities.lore: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.

options: +125 Frost Blast Radius and Area Damage

abilities.name: Earth Spike
abilities.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
notes: The spikes move at 2800 units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
abilities.lore: The Demon Witch exercises his demonic covenant, opening a fissure from hell.

abilities.name: Hex
abilities.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
notes: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of 120, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
abilities.lore: Lion is compelled to share his transfiguration, twisting the essence of those who oppose him.

abilities.name: Mana Drain
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%.

 Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.
notes: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
abilities.lore: Lesser magi are nothing more than a source of magical restoration for the Demon Witch.
abilities.shard: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to 2 additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance while channeling.

abilities.name: To Hell and Back
abilities.desc:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

abilities.name: Finger of Death
abilities.desc:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with 250 range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills.

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
notes: Finger of Death has a 0.25 delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within 3 seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.
abilities.lore: Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.
abilities.scepter: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

options: +15% To Hell And Back Debuff/Spell Amp
+20 Finger of Death Damage Per Kill
Earth Spike affects a 30 degree cone

abilities.name: Ether Shock
abilities.desc: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
notes: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.
abilities.lore: Originally used to open shows with the travelling con-man, Rhasta's lightning display shocks adversaries in more ways than one.

abilities.name: Hex
abilities.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
notes: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of 100, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
abilities.lore: Rhasta often ended performances by turning himself into a chicken - now, the humiliation is shared.

abilities.name: Shackles
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
abilities.lore: A self-defense incantation, Rhasta developed shackles after his master was slain in the Bleeding Hills.
abilities.scepter: Increase cast range. Every 0.9 seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within 600 of the target for 100% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within 2000 units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

abilities.name: Fowl Play
abilities.desc:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
abilities.lore: Rhasta had to learn early on how to stay one step ahead of those who (rightfully or wrongfully) wished him harm.
abilities.shard: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to 1 seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for 0.1 seconds. additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.

abilities.name: Urnaconda
abilities.desc: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts 15s.

abilities.name: Mass Serpent Ward
abilities.desc: Summons 10 Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
abilities.lore: Snake charming was a big part of the Shadow Shaman's act; now Rhasta can empower the snakes to do his bidding.
abilities.shard: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.

abilities.name: Guardian Sprint
abilities.desc: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has 100% slow resistance for the first 2.5s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
notes: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.
abilities.lore: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.

abilities.name: Slithereen Crush
abilities.desc: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
abilities.lore: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.
abilities.scepter: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.
abilities.shard: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.

abilities.name: Bash of the Deep
abilities.desc: After 3 attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
notes: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
abilities.lore: Thieves of the wealth of the Deep Ones meet the brutality of the Slithereen Guard in melee combat.

abilities.name: Seaborn Sentinel
abilities.desc: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
abilities.scepter: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by 75% and puddle/trail duration by 5s.

abilities.name: Corrosive Haze
abilities.desc: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
abilities.lore: Even the strongest armor counts for little when left to the brine of the sea.

abilities.name: Gush
abilities.desc: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
abilities.lore: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.
abilities.scepter: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line. Decreases cooldown.

abilities.name: Kraken Shell
abilities.desc:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of 40% movement speed. Lasts 4s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.lore: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.

abilities.name: Anchor Smash
abilities.desc: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus 225 units.
notes: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.

abilities.name: Dead in the Water
abilities.desc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.
abilities.lore: Anchors Aweigh!

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.desc: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
notes: Ravage will hit invisible units.
Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of 725.
abilities.lore: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.

abilities.name: Leviathan's Catch
abilities.desc:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain 3 Health, 2 Attack Range, and 1 Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
notes: Enemies can destroy the fish.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

options: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash

abilities.name: Paralyzing Cask
abilities.desc: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
notes: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.
abilities.lore: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.

abilities.name: Voodoo Restoration
abilities.desc: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
notes: Healing is done in 0.33 second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.
abilities.lore: Zharvakko's hocus pocus is not limited only to hexxing his opponents and is quite adept at curing ailments.

abilities.name: Maledict
abilities.desc: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
notes: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.
abilities.lore: Certain voodoo magics can make an enemy regret engaging the Witch Doctor.

abilities.name: Voodoo Switcheroo
abilities.desc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

abilities.name: Gris-Gris
abilities.desc:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s.

 Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

abilities.name: Death Ward
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8 seconds. Death Ward has 50% bonus accuracy.
notes: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
abilities.lore: Witch Doctor performs a ritualistic dance, one that haunts the dreams of those who live to recount it.
abilities.scepter: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.

options: Maledict bursts deal 75% damage in a 800 AoE
+1% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Heal

abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.desc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
notes: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
abilities.lore: Since his escape during the night of his betrayal, Riki has valued the use of a simple smoke screen to confuse his opponents.
abilities.shard: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by 5 and cannot be targeted by their allies.

abilities.name: Blink Strike
abilities.desc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by 100% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
abilities.lore: The Stealth Assassin's agile movement makes him impossible to escape.

abilities.name: Tricks of the Trade
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes 2 random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
abilities.lore: The Stealth Assassin is not afraid to fight dirty, and specializes in attacking his opponents from behind.
abilities.scepter: Increases Cast Range to 500. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have 15% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts 1s longer and does an additional 2 attacks.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.desc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
notes: Works when denying friendly units at 30% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.

abilities.name: Cloak and Dagger
abilities.desc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
abilities.lore: Riki comes for you.

options: 15% of Riki's Base damage added to Tricks of the Trade

abilities.name: Malefice
abilities.desc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances. An instance strikes every 2 seconds.
abilities.lore: Strange gravities pull at the core of those who would oppose you, holding them in place.
abilities.shard: Increases Malefice stun duration by 0.3s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

abilities.name: Demonic Summoning
abilities.desc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health. The eidolons health is increased by 3% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply. When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
abilities.lore: Enigma is capable of drawing aspects of himself from other dimensions - the result is a trio of dark eidolons that hunt the corporeal plane.

abilities.name: Midnight Pulse
abilities.desc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
notes: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.
abilities.lore: A section of the world slowly descends into the void.

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.desc: Units in a 600 radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units. Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
abilities.lore: The ground trembles as Enigma channels his ultimate vortex of destruction, a singularity with the power to end worlds.
abilities.scepter: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to 4% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a 1000 AoE. Pulls at a rate of 150.

abilities.name: Laser
abilities.desc: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
abilities.lore: Boush perfected this rock cutting laser in his subterranean laboratory, never considering its combat utility.
abilities.scepter: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by 13% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

abilities.name: March of the Machines
abilities.desc: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
notes: Robots spawn at a rate of 24 per second.
abilities.lore: Even though the laboratory has since been sealed off, the ability to radio in robotic drones is still in working order.
abilities.scepter: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.

abilities.name: Deploy Turrets
abilities.desc: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.
abilities.scepter: Turrets fire missiles 20% faster.

abilities.name: Warp Flare
abilities.desc:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
notes: Max teleportation distance is 60% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.
abilities.lore: Tinker's deadliest weapon instantly turns an enemy into space dust. Research to resolve the annoying 'perfect copy' side effect... is ongoing.

abilities.name: Rearm
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
abilities.lore: A new battery here, another set of rockets there, Boush continually improves on existing technology.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.desc: Tinker gains 1% item cooldown reduction per 3 Intelligence, up to a maximum of 60%.

abilities.name: Shrapnel
abilities.desc: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every 35 seconds.
notes: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Does not damage buildings.
Provides vision in the targeted area.
abilities.lore: Kardel's modular rifle also fires incendiary rounds, useful for assaulting entrenched locations.

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.desc: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal 20 / 50 / 80 / 110 extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by -100%.
abilities.lore: Taking potshots at steepstalkers in his childhood has been thoroughly refined into perfect leads on enemy combatants.

abilities.name: Take Aim
abilities.desc:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by 160 / 240 / 320 / 400.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by 65% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
abilities.lore: Kardel always takes it upon himself to stay as far from harm as he can while still performing his role - taking perfect aim.

abilities.name: Concussive Grenade
abilities.desc: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
abilities.lore: ATTN: IN CASE OF DANGER PULL PIN
abilities.shard: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.

abilities.name: Keen Scope
abilities.desc: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every 100 units of distance Sniper is from the target.

abilities.name: Assassinate
