abilities.desc: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
notes: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.
abilities.lore: In order to fulfill the prophecy and return to his home town, Kardel must make another shot as perfect as the one on the day of his ancient test.
abilities.scepter: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.

abilities.name: Death Pulse
abilities.desc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
notes: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.
abilities.lore: Poor souls who succumb to Rotund'jere's plagues are recycled for future use.

abilities.name: Ghost Shroud
abilities.desc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
abilities.lore: Rotund'jere uses the souls of his victims as bridge from life to afterlife.

abilities.name: Heartstopper Aura
abilities.desc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
notes: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.
abilities.lore: Those who come within a short distance of Necrophos can feel pestilence and plague in the air.
abilities.scepter: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by 50% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

abilities.name: Death Seeker
abilities.desc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.
abilities.lore: The Rumusque Faithful consider Necrophos to be more plague than person.

abilities.name: Sadist
abilities.desc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for 8 seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Reaper's Scythe
abilities.desc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
notes: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.
abilities.lore: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of Necrophos's plague magic.

options: +0.3 Reaper's Scythe Damage Per Missing HP

abilities.name: Fatal Bonds
abilities.desc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
notes: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.

abilities.name: Shadow Word
abilities.desc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
abilities.lore: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.
abilities.scepter: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to additional units in a radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to 10 / 12 / 14 / 16 seconds. Enemies are slowed for 1 second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
notes: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
abilities.lore: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
abilities.shard: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every 2 seconds that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

abilities.name: Eldritch Summoning
abilities.desc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
abilities.shard: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

abilities.name: Chaotic Offering
abilities.desc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 0.8 seconds. The Golem lives 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
notes: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
abilities.lore: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
abilities.scepter: Calls 2 Golems.

options: +8 Upheaval Attack Speed per second on Allies
25% Damage Resistance for Chaotic Offering Golems

abilities.name: Wild Axes
abilities.desc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path. Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
notes: This ability destroys trees.
abilities.lore: While learning to maneuver in nature alone, the Beastmaster also mastered the use of a pair of tomahawks, adept at cutting down trees as well as adversaries.
abilities.shard: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.

abilities.name: Summon Razorback
abilities.desc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
abilities.lore: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.

abilities.name: Summon Raptors
abilities.desc: Beastmaster summons 2 hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
abilities.lore: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.
abilities.shard: Increases Hawk duration by s and summons an additional Hawk.

abilities.name: Inner Beast
abilities.desc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
notes: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.
abilities.lore: Beastmaster's ability to incite the innate strength of animals was seen in the mauling of the king of Slom.

abilities.name: Drums of Slom
abilities.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.
abilities.lore: Nature's rage is timeless, and for those who know the secrets, it's easy to stir the echoes of ire that rejoiced in the downfall of Slom.

abilities.name: Primal Roar
abilities.desc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain 40% movement speed for 2 seconds.
abilities.lore: The Beastmaster has learned to channel his primal instincts into an animalistic roar, causing devastation in the ranks of enemies.

options: +1.5% Wild Axes Damage Amp Per Stack
+15 Movespeed to Beastmaster and his summons
+25 Damage to Beastmaster and his summons
+250 Health to Beastmaster and his summons

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.desc: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for 16 seconds. An instance of damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
notes: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.
abilities.lore: Akasha's envenomed dagger allows her to delight in the drawn out suffering of her victims.
abilities.scepter: Causes Shadow Strike to become a 300 AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
notes: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
abilities.lore: The Secret Queen lives up to her title, making her pain impossible to escape.
abilities.shard: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals 125 damage in a 300 AoE and silences the target for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Scream Of Pain
abilities.desc:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.

25% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
notes: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: The sultry voice of Akasha beckons her opponents while stealing their souls.

abilities.name: Succubus
abilities.desc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is 150 units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is 800 units or further from her.

abilities.name: Sonic Wave
abilities.desc: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
notes: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.
abilities.lore: Her most exquisite of all of torments, Akasha's Sonic Wave puts her poor foes out of their misery.

options: +35 Attack Speed against Shadow Striked units

abilities.name: Venomous Gale
abilities.desc: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement. Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
notes: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
Slow starts at -35 / -40 / -45 / -50%, and decreases as time passes.
abilities.lore: A concoction of various stings, poisons, and toxins gathered from the jungles of Jidi Isle, victims surviving it are rare.
abilities.shard: Increases cast range and projectile speed by 25%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, 2 Plague Wards are created around them.

abilities.name: Snakebite
abilities.desc: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

abilities.name: Plague Ward
abilities.desc: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
abilities.lore: A mixture of his old herbalist talents and newfound toxic mastery creates a living embodiment of plague.

abilities.name: Poison Sting
abilities.desc: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
notes: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.
abilities.lore: The paralytic sting of the creature which caused his transformation now belongs to the Venomancer.
abilities.shard: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to % of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

abilities.name: Noxious Plague
abilities.desc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
notes: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
abilities.lore: Deep in the heart of the jungles of Jidi, the seeds of extermination freely grow.
abilities.scepter: Decreases cooldown by seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.

abilities.name: Time Walk
abilities.desc: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last 2 seconds.
notes: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.
abilities.lore: Darkterror tears a hole in time, passing through Claszureme, and appearing back in an instant.
abilities.scepter: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.

abilities.name: Time Dilation
abilities.desc: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
notes: Does not affect item cooldowns.
Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.
abilities.lore: For those facing off against Darkterror, each moment seems to stretch into eternity.
abilities.shard: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.

abilities.name: Time Lock
abilities.desc: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
notes: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
abilities.lore: The strike of the Faceless Void lands with dimension shifting force.

abilities.name: Reverse Time Walk
abilities.desc: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.
abilities.lore: It's all relative.

abilities.name: Distortion Field
abilities.desc: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a 1200 radius of him get slowed by 40%, when they get within 500 distance of their target.

abilities.name: Chronosphere
abilities.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
notes: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.
abilities.lore: When a rift opens to Claszureme, all poor souls caught within will likely never return.

abilities.name: Wraithfire Blast
abilities.desc: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
abilities.lore: Ostarion calls on his damned lineage, laying waste to his opponents.

abilities.name: Bone Guard
abilities.desc: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.
abilities.lore: Wraith King's blade drains his enemy's essence to feed his aura.

abilities.name: Mortal Strike
abilities.desc: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
abilities.lore: One blow to crush a foe.
abilities.shard: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take 75% of the initial attack damage again as Pure damage after a 3 second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.

abilities.name: Vampiric Spirit
abilities.desc: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
notes: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
Does not affect Reincarnate deaths.
Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.
abilities.scepter: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.

abilities.name: Reincarnation
abilities.desc: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle. Upon death, enemy units in a 600 radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
notes: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.
abilities.lore: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.
abilities.scepter: Reduces cooldown.

abilities.name: Crypt Swarm
abilities.desc: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
notes: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
abilities.lore: Krobelus' many trips to the grave gather a flock of the damned.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.desc: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
notes: Doesn't prevent usage of items.
abilities.lore: Peering into the veil of her opponent's demise, Krobelus sees a silent future.

abilities.name: Spirit Siphon
abilities.desc: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
notes: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
abilities.lore: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.
abilities.shard: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by 1 and causes enemies to be feared for 1 seconds if they are siphoned for 3 seconds consecutively.

abilities.name: Witchcraft
abilities.desc: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.

abilities.name: Exorcism
abilities.desc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts 40 seconds.
notes: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
abilities.lore: Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.
abilities.scepter: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

options: Deaths During Exorcism Extend Duration By +8s

abilities.name: Stifling Dagger
abilities.desc: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing 65 / 70 / 75 / 80+30 / 45 / 60 / 75% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
notes: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.
abilities.lore: The first skill learned by the Sisters of the Veil often signals an incoming hit.

abilities.name: Phantom Strike
abilities.desc: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Mortred's silken veil is the last thing her unfortunate target sees.

abilities.name: Blur
abilities.desc: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
notes: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.
abilities.lore: Meditation allows a Veiled Sister to carefully anticipate her opponents in combat.
abilities.shard: Decreases Cooldown by s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance 60% of their max cooldown values.

abilities.name: Fan of Knives
abilities.desc: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.
abilities.lore: A sister is generally given a single name, but powerful names often have plentiful allies.

abilities.name: Immaterial
abilities.desc:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

abilities.name: Coup de Grace
abilities.desc: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
abilities.lore: A divine strike, Mortred honors her opponent by choosing them for death.

abilities.name: Nether Blast
abilities.desc: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area. Deals 65% damage to structures.
notes: Damage is delayed by 0.8 seconds.
abilities.lore: The Arts of Oblivion include a deafening blast of emerald flames from the Nether Reaches.

abilities.name: Decrepify
abilities.desc: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
notes: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.
abilities.lore: A now-mastered relic from his childhood, Pugna delights in banishing others into the Nether Realm, whether for good, evil, or simple enjoyment.

abilities.name: Nether Ward
abilities.desc: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
notes: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Nether Ward can be decrepified.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.
abilities.lore: While at the lamasery for the Arts of Oblivion, Pugna learned to dominate his classmates with a simple ward charged with Nether magic.
abilities.shard: Increases cast range to 375.

abilities.name: Oblivion Savant
abilities.desc:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives 1.5% spell amplification per destroyed tower.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
abilities.lore: Pugna has truly become more powerful than even the grandmaster of Oblivion.
abilities.scepter: Reduces cooldown by 50s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by 8% per second up to a maximum of 75% and increases his own, up to a maximum of 100%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is 4% instead. Debuff lasts 8 seconds.
abilities.shard: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within 700 units of the ward for 75% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.

abilities.name: Refraction
abilities.desc: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage. The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
notes: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
abilities.lore: Manipulating her psionic veil, Lanaya bends nature's law to her will.
abilities.shard: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.

abilities.name: Meld
abilities.desc: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for 6 seconds. Bonus damage and debuffs from Meld are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
notes: Meld is broken by any action other than staying in position or channeling Psionic Projection.
Meld's armor reduction does not work against towers.
abilities.lore: Lanaya is as elusive as her covenant with the Hidden Temple.

abilities.name: Psi Blades
abilities.desc: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
notes: Split damage hits invisible units.
Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.
abilities.lore: Her blades pierce the skin as much as the mind, furthering her understanding of the mystery that is reality.

abilities.name: Psionic Projection
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.
abilities.lore: In reward for her service, Lanaya has been granted access to secrets that unlock new techniques for her psionic gifts.

abilities.name: Psionic Trap
abilities.desc: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of 20% in a 400 radius. Trap movement slow charges up to 50% after 3.5 seconds. Deals damage after 3.5s.
notes: Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over 2 seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
abilities.lore: Calling upon the reach of the Hidden Temple, none escape the eye of the Templar.
abilities.scepter: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.

abilities.name: Inner Peace
abilities.desc: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for 0.2s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after 1.85s of meditating.

abilities.name: Poison Attack
abilities.desc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to 6 times.
abilities.lore: The Netherdrake's inborn toxic breath quickly drains the vitality of its afflicted.
abilities.shard: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.

abilities.name: Nethertoxin
abilities.desc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
notes: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.
abilities.lore: Poison from the Nether Reaches turns wounds into fatalities, and fatigue into death.

abilities.name: Corrosive Skin
abilities.desc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a 1200 radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: It is not unusual for sword and shield alike to corrode in the very hands of those who attack the Netherdrake.
abilities.scepter: Corrosive Skin applies 4x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within 500 distance of Viper. Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to 50% increased effect after 4s.

abilities.name: Nosedive
abilities.desc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
abilities.lore: It was thought that Netherdrake wings touch ground only in death, but some surmise that those who've witnessed more intentional landings merely haven't survived to tell the tale.

abilities.name: Predator
abilities.desc: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.

abilities.name: Viper Strike
abilities.desc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.
abilities.lore: Once used to slay his sadistic summoner, the most powerful of Netherdrake infections spreads through the veins of those foolish enough to cross Viper.

abilities.name: Lucent Beam
abilities.desc: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
abilities.lore: Selemene smites those who encroach upon the Nightsilver Woods.
abilities.shard: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant 0% of the damage amount.

abilities.name: Lunar Orbit
abilities.desc: Creates 4 glaives that rotate 225 radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
abilities.lore: None may approach Selemene's chosen without favor from the goddess herself.
abilities.shard: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains 20% bonus movement speed.

abilities.name: Moon Glaives
abilities.desc: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
notes: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.
abilities.lore: Carefully sharpened, Luna's boomerang-like weapon cuts a wide swath through enemy numbers.

abilities.name: Lunar Blessing
abilities.desc: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within 1200 range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.
abilities.lore: The Goddess of the Moon smiles upon her kin.

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.desc: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
notes: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
Will not hit invisible units.
There is a 0.6 seconds gap between beams, 0.3 seconds with scepter.
abilities.lore: In times of great need, Selemene herself descends into the world, blocking out the light and hope of the opposed.
abilities.scepter: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.

options: Lucent Beam Hits An Additional Target

abilities.name: Breathe Fire
abilities.desc: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
abilities.lore: Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.

abilities.name: Dragon Tail
abilities.desc: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
abilities.lore: Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

abilities.name: Wyrm's Wrath
abilities.desc: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
abilities.lore: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.desc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
abilities.lore: Most Dragon Knights name no greater horror than the scourge of dragon's fire.

abilities.name: Dragon Blood
abilities.desc:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.

Regen and armor are increased by 50% during Elder Dragon Form.
abilities.lore: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

abilities.name: Elder Dragon Form
abilities.desc:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative.

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
abilities.lore: The dormant dragon power springs forth from within Davion, combining the powers of a legendary knight with a legendary Eldwurm.
abilities.scepter: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.desc: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
notes: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
abilities.lore: One of the few Dezun rites used for offensive purposes, the paralytic enchantment often proves useful.

abilities.name: Shallow Grave
abilities.desc: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
notes: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.
abilities.lore: Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.

abilities.name: Shadow Wave
abilities.desc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby. Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
notes: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.
abilities.lore: While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.
abilities.scepter: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to 100% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

abilities.name: Weave
abilities.desc: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
abilities.lore: His ethereal journey into the Nothl realm has allowed Dazzle to mend together the powers of light and dark, creating shifting waves of enchantments.
abilities.shard: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for 60 per stack of Weave.

abilities.name: Nothl Projection
abilities.desc: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
notes: When Dazzle's spirit is further than 1600 units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.
abilities.lore: The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.
abilities.shard: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.

abilities.name: Battery Assault
abilities.desc: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
notes: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.
abilities.lore: Some of Rattletrap's contraptions don't quite work correctly, so detonating them proves useful as an offensive maneuver.

abilities.name: Power Cogs
abilities.desc:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by 50% of the mana burned.

 Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to 850 / 900 / 950 / 1000 distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
notes: Cogs can shock invisible units.
abilities.lore: One of Clockwerk's inventions of which he is most proud is the power cog - though it is sometimes despised by his allies.

abilities.name: Rocket Flare
abilities.desc: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for 6 seconds.
abilities.lore: What started as a festive display has become a useful scouting and bombardment tool.

abilities.name: Overclocking
abilities.desc:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
abilities.lore: Rattletrap understands the limitations of his armor. Just as he understands the risks of pushing past them in times of need.

abilities.name: Jetpack
abilities.desc: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
abilities.lore: Sure it's blown up over fourteen testing dummies, but at least they all flew!

abilities.name: Hookshot
abilities.desc: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location. If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a 175 radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
notes: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.
abilities.lore: A somewhat unwieldy device, the Hookshot sends the otherwise clunky Clockwerk armor flying through the air.

abilities.name: Armor Power
abilities.desc:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.25% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.

abilities.name: Split Earth
abilities.desc: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
notes: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a 0.35 second delay before the effect is applied.
abilities.lore: Twisting nature to his vile will, the shifting earth consumes those unlucky enough to cross Leshrac's path.
abilities.shard: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location 2 additional times, with a 5 second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by 45. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.

abilities.name: Diabolic Edict
abilities.desc: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings. The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
notes: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.
abilities.lore: Chronoptic energy bursts from one plane to the other, evaporating anything it touches.

abilities.name: Lightning Storm
abilities.desc: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.
abilities.lore: The Tormented Soul's mastery of the elements is evident in the massive storms that strike down armies before him.

abilities.name: Nihilism
abilities.desc: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
abilities.lore: When it serves his purpose, Leshrac briefly reduces his presence in the Terrene Plane.

abilities.name: Defilement
abilities.desc: Leshrac gains 0.7 Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.

abilities.name: Pulse Nova
abilities.desc: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.
abilities.lore: If necessary, the Tormented Soul can manipulate space time itself, ravaging lesser beings.

options: Diabolic Edict Hits An Additional Target

abilities.name: Sprout
abilities.desc: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a 400 radius.
notes: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
abilities.lore: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.

abilities.name: Teleportation
abilities.desc: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
notes: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed. Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.
abilities.lore: The Prophet keeps his sentinel over the forest, protecting it when in need.

abilities.name: Nature's Call
abilities.desc: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
notes: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.
abilities.lore: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.

abilities.name: Curse of the Oldgrowth
abilities.desc: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.
abilities.lore: Though powerful, Nature's Prophet's gifts do not include all-sight, and he must rely heavily upon reconnaissance and aid from a long-standing network of stalwart friends.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Forest
abilities.desc: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.
notes: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.

abilities.name: Wrath of Nature
abilities.desc: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after 16 are hit.
notes: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.
abilities.lore: Nature's Prophet calls Verodicia's fury to strike down those who might ravage the wilderness.
abilities.scepter: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from 1.5s up to 3s seconds at max bounce.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.desc:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore: The madness and brutality of N'aix makes him a vicious and unrelenting foe in combat.

abilities.name: Open Wounds
abilities.desc: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
notes: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.
abilities.lore: Fresh wounds and the scent of blood often draw out the scavengers to finish the job.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.desc: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
notes: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
abilities.lore: After escaping from his cell in Devarque, N'aix subsisted on flesh and bones of those unfortunate to cross his path.

abilities.name: Ghoul Frenzy
abilities.desc: Passively grants Lifestealer Attack Speed.
abilities.lore: Distant memories of the Vile Council fuel one mind to plotting and the other to more immediate dark ends.

abilities.name: Infest
abilities.desc:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
abilities.lore: With this infestation, N'aix consumes the life blood of the host, restoring him back to full unholy power.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to s. Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
abilities.shard: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.

options: 50 Attack Speed on Open Wounds Target

abilities.name: Vacuum
abilities.desc: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
notes: This ability interrupts channeling.
Pulls units over 0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.
abilities.lore: Ish'Kafel modifies the center of gravity to a place of his choosing.

abilities.name: Ion Shell
abilities.desc: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
notes: Deals small amounts of damage in 0.2 second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.
abilities.lore: The Dark Seer slices holes into the 'Land Behind the Wall,' causing prismatic energy to seep forth.

abilities.name: Surge
abilities.desc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
notes: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.
abilities.lore: Ish'Kafel once used his speed of mind to navigate the maze between the walls.
abilities.shard: Surged units leave behind a 150 radius trail that lasts 7s, slows enemies around it by 35% and deals 40 damage per second in 0.5s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.

abilities.name: Normal Punch
abilities.desc: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.
abilities.lore: As a young soldier, long before he became a leader of his people, Ish'Kafel was known amongst his fellow recruits as quite the pugilist.

abilities.name: Quick Wit
abilities.desc:
Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

abilities.name: Wall of Replica
abilities.desc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
notes: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.
abilities.lore: The Dark Seer, while unable to return to his natural realm, can channel part of the prismatic wall with powerful strength of mind, sowing confusion amongst enemy ranks.

abilities.name: Strafe
abilities.desc:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a 1200 radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and 40% of the attack speed bonus.

 Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.
abilities.lore: The closest Clinkz can come to peace is knowing that this was the last thing Maraxiform ever saw.

abilities.name: Searing Arrows
abilities.desc:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for 50% damage.
notes: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.
abilities.lore: Clinkz simply lights his arrows from his flaming essence for quite the destructive effect.

abilities.name: Death Pact
abilities.desc: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
notes: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.
abilities.lore: Sutherex' bond of life and death has become a part of Clinkz, and his old bones are refreshed with repetition of the pact on lesser beings.

abilities.name: Burning Barrage
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
notes: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.
abilities.lore: It's hard to say whether the blur around the Bone Fletcher is from his flaming heart or his speed with the quiver.

abilities.name: Burning Army
abilities.desc: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.
abilities.lore: Existing on the brink of life and death, Clinkz has learned to temporarily bridge the gap between the two.

abilities.name: Skeleton Walk
abilities.desc:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
notes: Has a fadetime of 0.6 seconds.
abilities.lore: With a burst of fire and puff of smoke, the Bone Fletcher was nowhere to be seen.

abilities.name: Infernal Shred
abilities.desc:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to 20% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor). Clinkz applies 3% per attack, and skeletons apply 1%.

Lasts 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Purification
abilities.desc: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
abilities.lore: Priests of the Omniscience are adept at removing impurities from fellow warriors.
abilities.shard: After a 3s delay, the target is Purified again with 65% effectiveness.

abilities.name: Repel
abilities.desc: Grants Debuff Immunity with 60% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.
abilities.lore: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.

abilities.name: Hammer of Purity
abilities.desc:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

 Omniknight heals for 40% of the damage dealt over 4s.
abilities.lore: The knight is merely a means to move the hammer.

abilities.name: Degen Aura
abilities.desc: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.
notes: Does not affect Debuff Immune units.
abilities.lore: The holy embodiment of Purist Thunderwrath is enough to weaken those of lesser faith.

abilities.name: Guardian Angel
abilities.desc: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
abilities.lore: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.
abilities.scepter: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.

options: +75% Hammer of Purity Bonus Base Damage

abilities.name: Impetus
abilities.desc: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is. The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
notes: The damage is capped at 1750 distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.
abilities.lore: While Aiushtha favors peaceful means, she is capable of a magical onslaught from a distance, her spears gaining energy from the natural life around her.

abilities.name: Enchant
abilities.desc:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty. Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30 / 60 / 90 / 120s.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Illusions can be converted.
abilities.lore: A true steward of the forest, Aiushtha befriends all within it - from lowly trolls to powerful centaurs.
abilities.scepter: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.

abilities.name: Nature's Attendants
abilities.desc: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
notes: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.
abilities.lore: Whimsical spirits of the woods possess a healing power that is quite subtle, but gains strength in numbers.

abilities.name: Sproink
abilities.desc: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.
abilities.lore: Sproink is as Sproink does.

abilities.name: Little Friends
abilities.desc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.
abilities.lore: The laws of the forest may be oblique, but punishment for breaking them is swift and smiling.

abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.desc: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
notes: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.
abilities.lore: After attacking Aiushtha, most opponents are overwhelmed with guilt having attacked such a natural beauty.

abilities.name: Rabble-Rouser
abilities.desc: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.
notes: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.

options: +5 Armor for Enchantress and her units
+30 Attack Speed for Enchantress and her units
+150 Health / +25 Damage for Enchantress and her units

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.desc: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
abilities.lore: Not even Huskar's own flesh can contain the unending expansion of his life force.

abilities.name: Burning Spear
abilities.desc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack. Multiple attacks will stack additional damage. Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
notes: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target. There is no cap.
Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.
abilities.lore: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.
abilities.scepter: Burning Spears launches an additional spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.

abilities.name: Berserker's Blood
abilities.desc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
notes: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than 10% HP.
abilities.lore: After losing his birthright, Huskar gained a lethality in physical combat that is only heightened as his own blood is spilled.
abilities.shard:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Blood Magic
abilities.desc:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

abilities.name: Life Break
abilities.desc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed. While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.
abilities.lore: No matter the danger, Huskar thrusts himself into melees that only he can survive.
abilities.scepter: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.

abilities.name: Void
abilities.desc: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
notes: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.
abilities.lore: Balanar creates a vortex of infinite night, tearing opponents violently into the eternal darkness that once was.
abilities.shard: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.

abilities.name: Crippling Fear
abilities.desc: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him. The effect lasts longer at night.
abilities.lore: A vision of the twisted maw of Balanar etches itself into the minds of the poor souls unlucky enough to cross his path.

abilities.name: Midnight Feast
abilities.desc: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
notes: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.

abilities.name: Hunter in the Night
abilities.desc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
abilities.lore: The hunting prowess of Balanar improves as the night beckons.
abilities.scepter: Increases bonus movement speed by % and attack speed by . Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
abilities.shard: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.

abilities.name: Dark Ascension
abilities.desc: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
abilities.lore: It is a humbling sight to see when the mightiest of warriors become afraid of the dark.

options: 20% Hunter in the Night Status Resistance

abilities.name: Insatiable Hunger
abilities.desc: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.
abilities.lore: While most of her prey is wrapped in silken cocoons and saved for her young, the Broodmother herself has a taste for wandering heroes.
abilities.shard: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by 4% every 1s.

abilities.name: Spin Web
abilities.desc:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
notes: Also affects Spiderlings.
abilities.lore: Weaving a bed of silken fibers, Arachnia's web both protects her and her offspring, as well as giving advancing opponents a sense of foreboding.

abilities.name: Incapacitating Bite
abilities.desc: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
notes: The miss chance stacks with evasion and terrain dodge chance.
abilities.lore: Paralytic toxins come from Black Arachnia's fangs, causing a slow and painful death to those who intrude on her webs.

abilities.name: Spinner's Snare
abilities.desc: Broodmother may create up to 5 invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time. Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered. Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.
abilities.lore: The slightest tremor of her web is all Arachnia needs to find her prey.

abilities.name: Spider's Milk
abilities.desc: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.

abilities.name: Spawn Spiderlings
abilities.desc: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for 4 seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
notes: If the target is killed within 20 seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.
abilities.lore: Black Arachnia continues to raise her young, even amidst the field of combat. The brood quickly learns how to support their mother.

options: +7% Spin Web Move Speed and Ignore Speed Limit

abilities.name: Shuriken Toss
abilities.desc: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed. The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.
abilities.lore: While the shuriken may be small, Gondar's precise aim can cause critical damage.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

abilities.name: Jinada
abilities.desc: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
abilities.lore: Gondar's vast experience ensures he never walks away from a transaction empty-handed.

abilities.name: Shadow Walk
abilities.desc: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell. If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
notes: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.
abilities.lore: The court jesters present during King Goff's assassination can recount no other image than a dancing shadow.

abilities.name: Friendly Shadow
abilities.desc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
abilities.lore: Useful for the rare instances when a contested bounty is actually wanted alive.

abilities.name: Big Game Hunter
abilities.desc: Bounty Hunter receives 20% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

abilities.name: Track
abilities.desc: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
notes: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
Track's effect is only visible to allies.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.
abilities.lore: Using his elevated senses of sight and smell, Gondar's hits have quite a good chance of success.

abilities.name: The Swarm
abilities.desc: Weaver launches a swarm of 12 young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
notes: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.
Beetles provide vision.
abilities.lore: Skitskurr opens a gap in the space time fabric, allowing young Weavers to slip through and aid him in combat.

abilities.name: Shukuchi
abilities.desc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
notes: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.
abilities.lore: As the Weavers worked in the fabric of creation, small wormholes allowed them to slip through time to better work their craft.
abilities.shard: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last 4.6 seconds. 0.2s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within 1200 range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack

abilities.name: Geminate Attack
abilities.desc: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
notes: Additional attacks leave Weaver 0.25 seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.
abilities.lore: Skitskurr's relationship with time is somewhat variable, causing his actions to be witnessed - and felt - more than once.
abilities.shard: Geminate Attack will also hit units within 1200 range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.

abilities.name: Time Lapse
abilities.desc:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.
abilities.lore: If Skitskurr does not deem the current reality of the world to fit his desires, he simply crawls back in time to right what was wronged.
abilities.scepter: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with 500 cast range.

abilities.name: Threads of Fate
abilities.desc: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

abilities.name: Dual Breath
abilities.desc: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
notes: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a 0.2 second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
abilities.lore: Pyrexae dragons have tremendously dangerous breath for each branch of the species; combining them is unimaginable.

abilities.name: Ice Path
abilities.desc: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
notes: It takes 0.2 seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.
abilities.lore: Jakiro's cunning right head calls upon its frozen heritage, glazing the earth with blistering cold.

abilities.name: Liquid Fire
abilities.desc: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
notes: Works on both units and buildings.
abilities.lore: The left maw of Jakiro opens, laying waste to any in its path.
abilities.shard: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.

abilities.name: Liquid Frost
abilities.desc: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
abilities.lore: The right maw of Jakiro opens, punishing all with bitter frost.
abilities.shard: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

abilities.name: Double Trouble
abilities.desc: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
notes: The second attack ignores Damage Block.

abilities.name: Macropyre
abilities.desc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
notes: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for 1 additional seconds.
abilities.lore: Ice and fire combine to rip the battlefield to shreds with extreme temperatures.
abilities.scepter: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by 60%.

options: +3.5% Liquid Frost and Fire Max Health Damage

abilities.name: Sticky Napalm
abilities.desc: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to 20 stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
notes: All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
Sticky Napalm deals 20% damage to creeps.
abilities.lore: It's not uncommon to hear the Rider cackle while he increases the flammability of his opponents.
abilities.shard:
Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.

Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.

abilities.name: Flamebreak
abilities.desc: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.
abilities.lore: A molotov cocktail is the weapon of choice for Batrider.

abilities.name: Firefly
abilities.desc: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
notes: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
The trail persists through Batrider's death.
abilities.lore: When an enemy escapes into the Yama Raskav Jungle, most would cut through the brush to find the fugitive. Batrider just chooses to destroy the jungle along with his foes.

abilities.name: Smoldering Resin
abilities.desc: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals 20% of the attack damage every 1s for 2s.

abilities.name: Flaming Lasso
abilities.desc: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities. Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
notes: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.
abilities.lore: Few dare to ask to ride on the bat, as Batrider gives them free of charge.
abilities.scepter: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within 650 units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.

options: Attacks apply 1 Stack of Sticky Napalm

abilities.name: Penitence
abilities.desc: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.
abilities.lore: Although Chen's brand of animal enthrallment isn't quite strong enough to control the minds of enemy heroes, it still tests their resolve in combat.

abilities.name: Holy Persuasion
abilities.desc: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.
notes: Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
The health of creeps already under Chen's control does not update to the new level upon leveling Holy Persuasion further.
Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.
abilities.lore: Although they may not be knights, Chen incorporates beasts into the Fold in the same way he himself was converted.
abilities.shard: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.

abilities.name: Divine Favor
abilities.desc:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.
abilities.lore: Chen's zeal is infectious, blessing his allies with vitality and compelling them to his side.

abilities.name: Zealot
abilities.desc:
Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy. The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage. The Zealot respawns next to Chen.

Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a 6 second delay. If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.

abilities.name: Hand of God
abilities.desc: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for 10 seconds afterwards.
notes: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.
abilities.lore: Using the mental link with his thralls, Chen calls down restoration and well-being to those who share his fanaticism.
abilities.scepter: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to 40s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to 6 seconds.
