The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with 60% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by 200%.

options: Hand of God applies a Strong Dispel
Hand of God Fully Heals Chen and His Creeps

abilities.name: Spectral Dagger
abilities.desc: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
notes: There is a 1 second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
abilities.lore: Mercurial's dagger eclipses the physical plane in shadow, a state in which mortals cower, but spectres thrive.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.desc:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
abilities.lore: With great focus of will, Mercurial can sometimes limit the extent of her division.

abilities.name: Dispersion
abilities.desc: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
notes: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
Illusions don't get this ability.
Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: A daunting task lies before enemies of Mercurial - killing a shadow with blade and magic.
abilities.shard: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by 50% of its base values for 5s. Cooldown 25. Manacost 50.

abilities.name: Desolate
abilities.desc: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a 350 radius around them.
notes: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
Spectre's illusions also have Desolate.
abilities.lore: Often times, warriors find themselves alone with a vision of Mercurial - the fated question is if it is the true Spectre.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.desc:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
abilities.lore: At the height of combat, Mercurial's physical manifestation shatters, and the shadowy pieces haunt those who still cling to life.
abilities.scepter:
The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a 400 area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for 2s and have their movement speed slowed by 50%.

Reduces cooldown by 20s.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.desc: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
notes: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.
abilities.lore: Lucifer's appetite and greed are never sated.
abilities.shard: Devour has 2 charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have 15% increased AoE and 40% increased spell amplification.

abilities.name: Scorched Earth
abilities.desc: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
notes: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.
abilities.lore: The Fallen One spreads destruction in his wake, sparing none from the flame which sustains him.

abilities.name: Infernal Blade
abilities.desc: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.66 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
notes: Interrupts channeling abilities.
abilities.lore: Lucifer shares the fire branding bestowed upon him at the time of his exile.

abilities.name: Doom
abilities.desc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, doom is sure to follow.
abilities.scepter: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a 350 radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.

abilities.name: Lvl ? Pain
abilities.desc: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After 2.5s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a 66 AoE for 10% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is 66% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of 6.
notes: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.

options: +1.5% Infernal Blade Max HP As Damage

abilities.name: Cold Feet
abilities.desc: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time. If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4 seconds.
notes: Deals damage every half second.
abilities.lore: Kaldr's presence draws those around him into a frozen void, threatening to lock them in an icy prison for eternity.

abilities.name: Ice Vortex
abilities.desc: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
notes: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.
abilities.lore: Frozen, caustic winds are at the whim of Kaldr, chilling the field of battle.

abilities.name: Chilling Touch
abilities.desc: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
abilities.lore: The Ancient Apparition's eternal knowledge brings a frigid enchantment to his attacks.
abilities.scepter: Removes cooldown.

abilities.name: Bone Chill
abilities.desc: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.
abilities.scepter: Increases Base Strength Reduction by 0.8.

abilities.name: Ice Blast
abilities.desc: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
notes: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
The area of effect is 300 + 50*TimeTraveled, capped at 1000.
Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.
abilities.lore: Ice storms from ages past flow through Kaldr's frosty limbs, crashing into the world and turning its inhabitants into monuments to his eternal power.
abilities.shard: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for 50% of the duration.

abilities.name: Earthshock
abilities.desc: Ursa leaps forward 250 units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for 4 seconds.
abilities.lore: The very steps of a male ursine shake the ground as well as the resolve of opposing warriors.
abilities.shard: Earthshock applies 3 Fury Swipes to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.desc: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
notes: Missing an attack still consumes a charge of Overpower.
abilities.lore: For a behemoth of his size, Ursa is deceptively nimble.

abilities.name: Fury Swipes
abilities.desc: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage. If the same target is not attacked after 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
notes: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.
abilities.lore: In nature, the wounded rarely survive the attacks of hungry predators.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.desc: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.desc:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.lore: Ulfsaar succumbs to his ancient spirit, becoming the most ferocious creature on the battlefield.
abilities.scepter: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.

abilities.name: Charge of Darkness
abilities.desc:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at 25% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after 1.5s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
notes: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
abilities.lore: Barathrum erupts from the darkness with unwieldy force.
abilities.shard: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by .

abilities.name: Bulldoze
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
abilities.lore: Barathrum warps the fabric of reality around him, lessening its influence on his physical form.

abilities.name: Greater Bash
abilities.desc: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
notes: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
abilities.lore: The signature strike of Barathrum's ghostly ball and chain.
abilities.scepter: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive 20% damage), and the original target takes 25% of Greater Bash's damage again.

abilities.name: Planar Pocket
abilities.desc: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
notes: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves 900 units away from the target.
abilities.lore: Barathrum's unyielding focus forms a pocket of planar convergence from which not even the most powerful arcane energies can escape.

abilities.name: Empowering Haste
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
notes: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.

abilities.name: Nether Strike
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
notes: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.
abilities.lore: Barathrum temporarily returns to the realm from where he came, bringing with him the retribution of both worlds.
abilities.scepter: Greatly increases knockback.

abilities.name: Rocket Barrage
abilities.desc: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts 3 seconds.
notes: Rocket Barrage can't hit units Gyrocopter has no vision over.
Rocket Barrage fired from Homing Missiles do not trigger Afterburner.
abilities.lore: Aurel's new craft has an increased payload for rockets, enhancing their rapid-fire capabilities.

abilities.name: Homing Missile
abilities.desc: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
notes: Towers do half damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.
abilities.lore: The biggest missile Aurel could possibly attach to his craft, The Bomb has carefully calculated aerodynamics and explosives for maximum impact.
abilities.shard: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a 700 area of effect after 1 second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.

abilities.name: Flak Cannon
abilities.desc: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks. Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike. Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.
notes: Attack range for the primary attack is unchanged.
abilities.lore: This newly revamped Gyrocopter has attached enough armaments to assault in a 360 degree radius.

abilities.name: Afterburner
abilities.desc: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

abilities.name: Side Gunner
abilities.desc: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a 700 unit radius every 1.3s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
notes: Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.

abilities.name: Call Down
abilities.desc: Call down 3 aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is 500 distance from the previous one.
notes: The visual indicator is visible to allies only.
abilities.lore: 'Bombs Away!'

abilities.name: Acid Spray
abilities.desc: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.
abilities.lore: Using traditional Alchemy from the Darkbrew family, Razzil concocts an acid that dissolves even the toughest metals.

abilities.name: Unstable Concoction
abilities.desc: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After 5 seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after 5.5 seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
notes: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw. Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.
abilities.lore: A silver lining to the failure of turning a mountain into gold, this volatile solution has destructive potential.

abilities.name: Corrosive Weaponry
abilities.desc:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply 2 stacks. Unstable Concoction applies 1 stack per second of brew time.
abilities.lore: A powerful solvent that turned out to work all too well.

values.label: BASE ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION PER STACK

abilities.name: Berserk Potion
abilities.desc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore: After Razzil's great grandfather tested an early version of this potion on himself, a surviving family member immediately saw the profit potential.

abilities.name: Greevil's Greed
abilities.desc: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next 40 seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
abilities.lore: While it is not a mountain, Razzil has mastered the conversion of smaller compounds to line his pockets.
abilities.scepter: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus 15 damage and 3 additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.

abilities.name: Chemical Rage
abilities.desc:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Has a 0.35 second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.
abilities.lore: The brew Razzil gave to the Ogre during their prison bust has become a useful potion in the midst of combat.

options: +1% Corrosive Weaponry Slow / Damage Reduction Per Stack
Greevil's Greed provides +3 Damage per stack

abilities.name: Quas
abilities.desc: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
abilities.lore: A quelling cold.
abilities.scepter: Grants 1 current and max level.

abilities.name: Wex
abilities.desc: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
abilities.lore: A withering wind.
abilities.scepter: Grants 1 current and max level.

abilities.name: Exort
abilities.desc: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
abilities.lore: An exacting flame.
abilities.scepter: Grants 1 current and max level.

abilities.name: Invoke
abilities.desc:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each orb level. Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels 6, 12, and 18.

Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options. The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen.

 Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
notes: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
abilities.lore: So begins a new age of knowledge.

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.
notes: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than 10 after reductions.
abilities.lore: Sadron's Protracted Frisson.

abilities.name: Ghost Walk
abilities.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.
notes: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.
abilities.lore: Myrault's Hinder-Gast.
abilities.shard: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.

abilities.name: Tornado
abilities.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
abilities.lore: Claws of Tornarus.
abilities.scepter: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a 150 radius every 0.25 seconds. (half damage to creeps.)

abilities.name: E.M.P.
abilities.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained. If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 25% of the mana drained.
notes: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
abilities.lore: Endoleon's Malevolent Perturbation.
abilities.shard: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at 125 units per second.

abilities.name: Alacrity
abilities.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.
abilities.lore: Gaster's Mandate of Impetuous Strife.

abilities.name: Chaos Meteor
abilities.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.
notes: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every 0.5 seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over 3 seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of 300.
abilities.lore: Tarak's Descent of Fire.

abilities.name: Sun Strike
abilities.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
notes: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
abilities.lore: Harlek's Incantation of Incineration.
abilities.scepter: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a 90 second cooldown. Creates 2 visible 75% damage Sun Strikes within 90-180 range of each enemy hero.
abilities.shard: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.

abilities.name: Forge Spirit
abilities.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.
notes: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.
abilities.lore: Culween's Most Cunning Fabrications.

abilities.name: Ice Wall
abilities.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.
abilities.lore: Killing Wall of Koryx.
abilities.scepter: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a 45 width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than 2.5 seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas.

abilities.name: Deafening Blast
abilities.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.
abilities.lore: Buluphont's Aureal Incapacitator.

abilities.name: Arcane Curse
abilities.desc:
Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.

Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
notes: Affects creeps.
abilities.lore: Nortrom's lack of incantations is less of a problem for him than it is for his adversaries.

abilities.name: Glaives of Wisdom
abilities.desc: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
abilities.lore: Although lacking in traditional incantations, Nortrom's pedigree of the Aeol Drias gives him uncanny wisdom, which he applies to physical combat.
abilities.shard: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce 1 time to a random enemy within 450 range and increases intelligence steal.

abilities.name: Last Word
abilities.desc: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
notes: Channeling abilities will trigger this effect once the caster finishes its channel.
abilities.lore: Nortrom ensures that spells uttered by his opponents will be their last.

abilities.name: Suffer In Silence
abilities.desc:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals 1 Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra 1 Intelligence.
abilities.shard: Increases the Intelligence stolen per kill.

abilities.name: Global Silence
abilities.desc: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
notes: This skill works on invisible and Debuff Immune units, but gaining debuff immunity will remove its effect.
Multiple Arcane Curses from Aghanim's Scepter Global Silence do not stack.
abilities.lore: With a shock to the ground, all magic and sound pauses, and Nortrom fulfills his prophecy.
abilities.scepter: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.

options: +7% Suffer In Silence Silenced Target Damage
+40s Glaives of Wisdom Int Steal Duration

abilities.name: Arcane Orb
abilities.desc: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
notes: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.
abilities.lore: Harbinger's outworldly knowledge allows it to tap into the ebb and flow of all spiritual energy, infusing it into his being.
abilities.scepter: Arcane Orb bounces to an additional target for % less damage.

abilities.name: Astral Imprisonment
abilities.desc: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
notes: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.
abilities.lore: Locked away in the pocket between this world and the Outworld, victims realize their infantile knowledge and mortality.
abilities.shard: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at 70% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).

abilities.name: Objurgation
abilities.desc: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.
abilities.scepter: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below 20% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every 80 seconds.

abilities.name: Essence Flux
abilities.desc: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.
abilities.lore: The Outworld is awash in arcane energy, inclined to diffuse through any of Harbinger's rifts.

abilities.name: Sanity's Eclipse
abilities.desc: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.
abilities.lore: When an Outworld crystal ruptures, cataclysmic energies are released, and the reverberations of this power are felt interdimensionally.

options: +0.8% of Current Mana as Movement Speed

abilities.name: Summon Wolves
abilities.desc: Summons 2 wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
notes: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.
abilities.lore: The very enchantment that twisted his being also summons canine familiars.
abilities.shard: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.

abilities.name: Howl
abilities.desc: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within 2000 range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.
abilities.lore: Blood-curdling wolf cries signal to opponents that Banehallow is among them.

abilities.name: Feral Impulse
abilities.desc: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.
abilities.lore: His animalistic symbiosis with canine kind gives Banehallow enhanced reflexes and hunting capabilities.

abilities.name: Wolf Bite
abilities.desc: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.
notes: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.
abilities.lore: Does this bite look infected?

abilities.name: Apex Predator
abilities.desc: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.desc: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed. Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
notes: Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.
abilities.lore: Forever a slave to his lycanthropy, Banehallow has come to accept his curse, and embrace his own savagery.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.desc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.
abilities.lore: A slam of Mangix' mighty keg starts the festivities.

abilities.name: Cinder Brew
abilities.desc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by 3s and causing them to take damage over time.
abilities.lore: The Order of the Oyo's solution to all problems - another round!

abilities.name: Drunken Brawler
abilities.desc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
notes: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.
abilities.lore: When Mangix won his title as the Brewmaster of the Order of Oyo, he also claimed his place in the mastery of inebriation.

abilities.name: Liquid Courage
abilities.desc: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.
abilities.shard:
Toss a strong drink to a teammate or drink it yourself, activating the maximum power effect of Liquid Courage and granting 3% Max HP Regen per second.

Lasts 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Primal Split
abilities.desc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn. Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
notes: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.
abilities.lore: It isn't clear whether Mangix is consciously aware of his potent bond with nature, as it often occurs in the midst of a drunken stupor.
abilities.scepter:
Primal Split gains 1 max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.

Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.

options: +2/1s Drunken Brawler Brew Up / Extend Duration
Cinder Brew applies Fear when ignited

abilities.name: Disruption
abilities.desc: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration. Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.
abilities.lore: The pain of deception comes not while it happens, but when it is revealed.

abilities.name: Disseminate
abilities.desc: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within 675 range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
notes: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: Friends and families share in the suffering when Shadow Demon finds a new victim.

abilities.name: Shadow Poison
abilities.desc: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to 5 stacks. Additional stacks cause 60 damage each. This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
notes: Shadow Poison can affect units under Disruption.
abilities.lore: The ever growing influence of the Shadow Demon can pollute the most valiant and pure of heroes.

abilities.name: Demonic Cleanse
abilities.desc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.
abilities.lore: The only one permitted to harm his more useful followers is Shadow Demon himself.

abilities.name: Demonic Purge
abilities.desc:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration. The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: The slow starts at 100% and decreases over time to 20%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.
abilities.lore: Once Shadow Demon no longer has any need for his collected cultist, he releases it from its subservience - and its life.
abilities.scepter: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain 2 charges.

abilities.name: Menace
abilities.desc: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for 8 seconds that increases their damage taken.
notes: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.desc:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies 2 stacks to each enemy hero in the area and 5 stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for 10s, making him apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
notes: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Entangled debuff is dispellable.
Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.
abilities.scepter: Entangle applies 5 stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.

abilities.name: Spirit Link
abilities.desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
notes: Break disables the shared lifesteal.
abilities.lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.
abilities.scepter:
Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for 20s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by 35%. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around.

 The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.

abilities.name: Savage Roar
abilities.desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by 20%.
notes: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.
abilities.lore: Sylla studies and masters the arts of the lost Bear Clan, enhancing his attunement with the wild.
abilities.shard:
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Summon Spirit Bear
abilities.desc:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
notes: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and % base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
abilities.lore: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.

abilities.name: True Form
abilities.desc: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
abilities.lore: The mighty bear is the king of the forest, possessing the throne through raw power.

abilities.name: Chaos Bolt
abilities.desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
notes: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.
abilities.lore: Even Chaos Knight cannot predict this manifest of unholy energy.
abilities.shard: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals 15% less damage.

abilities.name: Reality Rift
abilities.desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.
notes: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.
abilities.lore: Armageddon rides between the planes, bringing Chaos Knight to his victim wherever he may hide.
abilities.shard: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.

abilities.name: Chaos Strike
abilities.desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
abilities.lore: Chaos Knight's unwieldy power bludgeons those who stand before him, crushing the thickest of armors.

abilities.name: Fundamental Forging
abilities.desc: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
notes: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.

abilities.name: Phantasm
abilities.desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 60 / 80 / 100% damage, but take 350% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
abilities.lore: Drawing on his battles fought across many worlds and many times, phantasms of the Chaos Knight rise up to quell all who oppose him.
abilities.scepter:
Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a 50% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.

abilities.name: Earthbind
abilities.desc: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
notes: Affects invisible units, revealing them.
Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.
abilities.lore: Catching dinner in the Riftshadow Ruins can be quite the task.

abilities.name: Poof
abilities.desc:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for 1.5 seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
notes: Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.
abilities.lore: Sometimes breaking one of the Riftshadow Crystals can be just the trick for getting yourself out of a bind. Or your other self.

abilities.name: Ransack
abilities.desc:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.
notes: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification
abilities.lore: So you gonna need that, or...?

abilities.name: Dig
abilities.desc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore: I'm diggin' here!

abilities.name: MegaMeepo
abilities.desc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.
abilities.lore: Hi, Meepos!

abilities.name: Divided We Stand
abilities.desc:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them 50 / 66 / 75 / 80% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.
abilities.lore: Do I know you?

abilities.name: Geomancy
abilities.desc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within 250 range, he receives 1 HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives 2% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by 2% for 2 seconds.
notes: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.

abilities.name: MegaMeepo Fling
abilities.desc: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a 900 range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.
abilities.lore: You go first!

options: Earthbind grants True Strike on Targets

abilities.name: Nature's Grasp
abilities.desc: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.
abilities.lore: The tendrils of Rooftrellen's influence stretch to all corners of the forest.

abilities.name: Leech Seed
abilities.desc: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits 2 healing pulses to up to 5 nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
abilities.lore: Rooftrellen nurtures the beings under his stewardship, sustained by the lifeforce of trespassers into his sacred ground.

abilities.name: Living Armor
abilities.desc: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
notes: Instances of damage less than 10 are ignored.
abilities.lore: The roots and tendrils of the Treant Protectors are far-reaching, stimulating the growth and rejuvenation of all of nature.
abilities.shard: Increases the Damage Blocked by Living Armor. Treant now also passively benefits from Living Armor, with the damage block resetting after not taking damage for 0 seconds.

abilities.name: Eyes In The Forest
abilities.desc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 360 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
notes: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.
abilities.lore: One can never be too certain who, or what, might need protecting.

abilities.name: Nature's Guise
abilities.desc: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for 2.75 seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
notes: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.
abilities.lore: The Protectors don't often come into vision; their natural state being nestled within their leafy brethren.

abilities.name: Overgrowth
abilities.desc: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
notes: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.
abilities.lore: Rooftrellen calls the ancestral spirit of nature, releasing its power through all of his kin.
abilities.scepter: Decreases Cooldown to 25 seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for 16 seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of 345, 100% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals 60% of his attack damage in a 300 unit radius.

abilities.name: Fireblast
abilities.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
notes: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a 0.6 seconds interval.
abilities.lore: The Ogre Magi is easily amused, entertained for hours by playing with fire.
abilities.scepter: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by s and increasing cast speed by 25%.

abilities.name: Ignite
abilities.desc: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
notes: Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a 1400 area of effect.
Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.
abilities.lore: Batter up!

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.desc: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 700 area of effect to receive Bloodlust.
abilities.lore: 'Running's not as fun as hitting... Not one bit fun.'

abilities.name: Unrefined Fireblast
abilities.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
notes: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a 0.6 seconds interval.
abilities.lore: The 'who-casts-spell-first' argument between himself is solved simply by both casting at once.

abilities.name: Fire Shield
abilities.desc: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 1000 area of effect to receive Fire Shield.
abilities.lore: There is immense luck involved in Aggron not just setting friends on fire.

abilities.name: Dumb Luck
abilities.desc: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

abilities.name: Multicast
abilities.desc: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every 16 Strength adds 1%.
notes: Only targeted abilities and items have a chance to be multicast.
Targeted abilities and items apply to additional enemies and neutrals in an AoE around Ogre. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast hit the same target multiple times.
abilities.lore: Despite being largely incapacitated by his IQ, the Ogre Magi's success in battle is attributed to pure skill.

options: +2/0.01 Dumb Luck Mana/Mana Regen Per Strength

abilities.name: Decay
abilities.desc: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals 2x damage to creeps.
notes: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.
Affects invisible units.
abilities.lore: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.
abilities.scepter: Increases strength steal.

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.desc: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
notes: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.
abilities.lore: Even allies feel despair in Undying's presence.

abilities.name: Tombstone
abilities.desc: Summons a tombstone at the target point. Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them. Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
notes: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.
abilities.lore: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.
abilities.shard: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for 2 seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Ceaseless Dirge
abilities.desc: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.
abilities.lore: Only when the Dirge of the Dead God ceases will this soldier's march finally end.

abilities.name: Flesh Golem
abilities.desc: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem. While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
abilities.lore: The flesh of the recently dead add to the power of Dirge's plague.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.desc: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
notes: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.
abilities.lore: Even the Grandest Magus may use his powers for enjoyment.
abilities.shard: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to 225 and throw delay is reduced to 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Fade Bolt
abilities.desc: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.
abilities.lore: Rubick's favorite spell for dispatching would-be assassins is a rather simple conjuration.

abilities.name: Arcane Supremacy
abilities.desc: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.
abilities.lore: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...

abilities.name: Spell Steal
abilities.desc: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
notes: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
abilities.lore: ...but even their lesser magics can be a source of much utility.
abilities.scepter: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
abilities.shard: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.

abilities.name: Curiosity
abilities.desc:
Rubick gains 1 stack of Curiosity per level that grants him 1 base damage, 0.3% Buff/Debuff Duration, and 2 AOE Bonus.

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within 1200 distance of him, he gains 2 Curiosity for 20 seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last 3 seconds, he gains 1 Curiosity permanently.

abilities.name: Thunder Strike
abilities.desc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning. Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.3 seconds. Provides vision of its target.
abilities.lore: Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.
abilities.shard: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to 4 seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.

abilities.name: Glimpse
abilities.desc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.
abilities.lore: Playing with electricity can have unexpected results.

abilities.name: Kinetic Field
abilities.desc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
notes: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.
abilities.lore: The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.
abilities.shard: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

abilities.name: Kinetic Fence
abilities.desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
abilities.lore: For a brief moment, it's as if the wind itself had turned solid.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
abilities.desc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.
notes: After 7s, the damage counter is reset.
abilities.lore: Safe harbor found inside the storm.

abilities.name: Static Storm
abilities.desc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration. The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
abilities.lore: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.
abilities.scepter: Mutes items.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
notes: The spikes move at 1600 units per second, over 750 range.
Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.
abilities.lore: All zealot scarabs possess intimate knowledge of underground pathways, using them to their advantage.

abilities.name: Mind Flare
abilities.desc: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
abilities.lore: Only those raised by the queen can use their minds to touch the world around them.

abilities.name: Spiked Carapace
abilities.desc:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
notes: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled sources.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: While their carapace is relatively thin, it's guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.desc: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
notes: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.
abilities.lore: Some castes of zealot scarab are known to create small burrows to lie in wait, ready to ambush their prey.

abilities.name: Mana Burn
abilities.desc: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Vendetta
abilities.desc: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has 75 additional attack range and a 70% faster attack animation for this attack.
notes: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.
abilities.lore: The scarab kills for the glory of his queen.
abilities.shard: Decreases cooldown by s. For the first 15s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.desc:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Naga Siren is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.
abilities.lore: Slithice, while being strong in her own right, is notoriously hard to track down.

abilities.name: Ensnare
abilities.desc: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
abilities.lore: The only way to escape the onslaught of a Slithereen is to never oppose one in the first place.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range and projectile speed. Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

abilities.name: Rip Tide
abilities.desc: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for 4 seconds every 6 attacks.
notes: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.
abilities.lore: A torrent from the Deep Ones crushes the defenses of the Siren's enemies.

abilities.name: Eelskin
abilities.desc: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within 900 radius.

abilities.name: Song of the Siren
abilities.desc: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
notes: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.
abilities.lore: Slithice's powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.
abilities.shard: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled. Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path. The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
notes: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.
abilities.lore: Ezalor's hidden light reveals itself in marvelous fashion.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.desc: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is 175 range over 0.6 seconds.
notes: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.
abilities.lore: The Primordial light turns the tides of battle in favor of Ezalor and his allies.

abilities.name: Chakra Magic
abilities.desc: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is 30% more effective when used on himself.
notes: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.
abilities.lore: In the same vein, Ezalor bestows his harmony among others.

abilities.name: Solar Bind
abilities.desc: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
abilities.lore: Even a glimpse of the First Light is enough to rob enemies of their senses.
abilities.shard: Grants 2 charges.

abilities.name: Will-O-Wisp
abilities.desc: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.
abilities.lore: Though he would not claim to 'know' them, Ezalor holds an uncanny influence over many powerful creatures always willing to come to his aid.

abilities.name: Spirit Form
abilities.desc: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.
abilities.lore: In a flash of light, Ezalor reveals his true nature.
abilities.shard: Increases illuminate heal.

abilities.name: Bright Speed
abilities.desc:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every 3 Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves 300 distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see 400 range for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Tether
abilities.desc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
notes: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, Io will latch on and pull itself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.
abilities.lore: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.
abilities.shard: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for 50% of the damage done.

abilities.name: Spirits
abilities.desc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it. Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode. When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
notes: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.
abilities.lore: Io twists the particles of the universe with its unimaginable capabilities.
abilities.scepter: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.desc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
abilities.lore: Drawing on the energy of matter from all worlds, Io begins the unravelling of time.

abilities.name: Spirits In
abilities.desc: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

abilities.name: Spirits Out
abilities.desc: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

abilities.name: Relocate
abilities.desc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleport along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.
Only heroes, creep heroes, and illusions can be relocated.
abilities.lore: Io is the embodiment of the mystery of the universe.

abilities.name: Equilibrium
abilities.desc: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

abilities.name: Grave Chill
abilities.desc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
notes: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
Familiars within 900 range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.
abilities.lore: The warmth of the sun is never felt in the dark cold of the Narrow Maze.

abilities.name: Soul Assumption
abilities.desc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than 100 damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
notes: Charges are only gained for damage greater than 2 and less than 3000 that is dealt by a player or Roshan. Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
abilities.lore: The collected souls of the dead reach out to bring another into their fold.

abilities.name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
abilities.desc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within 900 range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
notes: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within 900 range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
abilities.lore: Visage's tough scales share equal properties of ghost and stone, making it nearly impervious to blade and magical assault.
abilities.shard: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to 25% of your health.

abilities.name: Silent as the Grave
abilities.desc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed. Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for 2s.
abilities.lore: Those on the mortal plane are blind to the stirrings of the agents of the afterlife.
abilities.scepter: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

abilities.name: Summon Familiars
abilities.desc:
Conjures 2 blind Familiars to fight for Visage. Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing. While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health. Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.
notes: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
abilities.lore: Guardians of the Narrow Maze, Necro'lic's Familiars stand watch over his domain.

options: +1 Armor Corruption to Visage and Familiars

abilities.name: Dark Pact
abilities.desc:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself. Slark only takes 30% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: 1.5 seconds after cast, a series of 10 pulses separated by 0.1 seconds deal the damage.
Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
You can't kill yourself with this skill.
The pulses stop if Slark dies.
abilities.lore: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.desc: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
notes: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of 933.33, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled 700 distance.
Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
abilities.lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.
abilities.scepter: Provides charges and increases range.

abilities.name: Saltwater Shiv
abilities.desc:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

abilities.name: Depth Shroud
abilities.desc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
abilities.lore: Nothing worse than a job going bad thanks to some clompy-footed friend.

abilities.name: Essence Shift
abilities.desc: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.
notes: Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.
abilities.lore: With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.

abilities.name: Shadow Dance
abilities.desc:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for 2 seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
abilities.lore: The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.

options: +1 Agility gain/stolen per Essence Shift Stack

abilities.name: Split Shot
abilities.desc:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
notes: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
abilities.lore: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.
abilities.scepter: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.

abilities.name: Mystic Snake
abilities.desc: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
notes: Mystic Snake cannot be disjointed.
abilities.lore: The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.

abilities.name: Gorgon's Grasp
abilities.desc: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
abilities.lore: The best predators don't even need to pounce.

abilities.name: Cold Blooded
abilities.desc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.
abilities.lore: Point your gaze at her if you dare.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.desc: Creates a shield that absorbs 98% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb 60% less damage per point of mana.
notes: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.
