abilities.lore: While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.

abilities.name: Stone Gaze
abilities.desc: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed. If 2 seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone. Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
notes: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.
abilities.lore: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.

abilities.name: Battle Stance
abilities.desc:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to 1.4.

Troll Warlord gains 1 armor per 30 bonus attack speed.
abilities.lore: Jah'rakal has a variety of ways to get under an enemy's skin.

abilities.name: Whirling Axes (Ranged)
abilities.desc: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over 950 range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
notes: Does not affect Roshan.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
abilities.lore: Only axes fueled by hate whirl with such a deadly spin.
abilities.scepter:
Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Whirling Axes (Melee)
abilities.desc: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
notes: Does not affect Roshan.
abilities.lore: Keep your enemies close.
abilities.scepter:
Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Fervor
abilities.desc: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed. If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.
abilities.lore: If at first you don't succeed, strike, strike again.
abilities.shard: Grants Troll 16% + 3% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus 175 when attacking an enemy unit.

abilities.name: Berserker's Rage
abilities.desc:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.
abilities.lore: Like his anger, Troll Warlord's supply of axes is infinite.

abilities.name: Battle Trance
abilities.desc:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within 900 range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.
abilities.lore: An adrenaline rush of pure hatred quickens your blades.

options: Allies Receive Battle Trance Attack Speed

abilities.name: Hoof Stomp
abilities.desc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.
abilities.lore: When the mighty hoof of the Warrunner touches soil, the tremors are felt far and wide.

abilities.name: Double Edge
abilities.desc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
notes: Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.
abilities.lore: In the spurs of combat, Bradwarden's vicious strikes sometimes cause self-inflicted collateral damage.
abilities.shard: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of 5 stacks.

abilities.name: Retaliate
abilities.desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
notes: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
Retaliate deals damage to towers.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: Bradwarden has no need to parry his opponent's attacks; his armor-like hide does it for him.

abilities.name: Work Horse
abilities.desc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
abilities.lore: It is a great honor to be offered a ride by Centaur Warrunner and a grave mistake to refuse it.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.desc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
abilities.lore: The great belt of Omexe, which labels Bradwarden as the greatest warrior of his kind, incites his fellow gladiators to follow him into barbarous combat.

abilities.name: Horsepower
abilities.desc:
Centaur Warrunner gains 40% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.desc: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.
abilities.lore: Mt. Joerlak was a somewhat unstable mass, and Magnus has learned to channel its reverberations.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.desc:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack.

 Empower is always on Magnus with 30% larger bonus.
notes: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.
abilities.lore: With a deep bellow, Magnus displays his true power.

abilities.name: Skewer
abilities.desc: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
notes: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
abilities.lore: Magnoceros horns are valuable in direct proportion to their danger to prospective merchants.
abilities.shard: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.

abilities.name: Horn Toss
abilities.desc: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
abilities.lore: Survivors of Joerlak will never forget the sight of Magnus tossing countless enemies into rivers of fire and clouds of ash.

abilities.name: Solid Core
abilities.desc: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

abilities.name: Reverse Polarity
abilities.desc: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.
abilities.lore: Magnus fights with the fury of the erupting Mt. Joerlak.

options: +14 All Attributes per hero hit with Reverse Polarity

abilities.name: Whirling Death
abilities.desc: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
abilities.lore: In the case that Rizzrack gets surrounded by the vines and plants of his nightmares, he has an immediate chainsaw defense.

abilities.name: Timber Chain
abilities.desc: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it. Any enemy in the path takes damage.
abilities.lore: You never know when you might need to escape from malevolent saplings.

abilities.name: Reactive Armor
abilities.desc: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as 4x the amount.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
abilities.lore: The saw-suit is equipped to react to the slightest touch with fortified defenses.
abilities.scepter: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and 150 damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw 100 + 75 barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within 450 radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of 800. After 8 seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within 450 radius equal to 200 + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.

abilities.name: Flamethrower
abilities.desc: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.
abilities.lore: A single saw can only cut so much. A single spark can burn forever.

abilities.name: Chakram
abilities.desc: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted. While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
notes: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over 2000 distance away.
abilities.lore: The ultimate in anti-flora weaponry.

abilities.name: Exposure Therapy
abilities.desc: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

options: +6 Max / +1 Hero Attack Reactive Armor Stacks
Exposure Therapy Heals for 12 HP Per Tree Destroyed

abilities.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
abilities.desc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for 5 seconds. Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
abilities.lore: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.

abilities.name: Quill Spray
abilities.desc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback. Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14 seconds.
notes: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
abilities.lore: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing. So can his quills.

abilities.name: Bristleback
abilities.desc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
notes: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.lore: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
abilities.scepter: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by -40%.

abilities.name: Hairball
abilities.desc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
abilities.lore: Every part of Bristleback's body is a weapon -- even the parts he accidentally swallowed.

abilities.name: Warpath
abilities.desc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
notes: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Items will not trigger Warpath.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
abilities.lore: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided. But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.

abilities.name: Prickly
abilities.desc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

abilities.name: Ice Shards
abilities.desc: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 seconds.
notes: Creates an impassable barrier.
abilities.lore: In the frozen tundra near the Barrier, after the last sun of autumn has set, ice can form with alarming speed.

abilities.name: Snowball
abilities.desc: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a 325 radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
notes: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.
abilities.lore: Tales are still told of the wild feat that ended the grand brawl at White Fields.

abilities.name: Tag Team
abilities.desc: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts 6 seconds.
notes: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.
abilities.lore: Even far from Cobalt, Tusk carries the 'Barrier Chill' in his very bones.

abilities.name: Drinking Buddies
abilities.desc: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
notes: Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within 250 range of each other.
Cannot be used during Snowball.
abilities.lore: The only thing better than finding a good drinking buddy is finding an equally good enemy the two of you can punch.

abilities.name: Walrus Kick
abilities.desc: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.
abilities.lore: Tusk may have made his name with his fists, but the wise enemy is wary of any and all limbs.

abilities.name: Walrus PUNCH!
abilities.desc: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
notes: Walrus PUNCH has true strike.
abilities.lore: It never matters who throws the first punch, only who throws the last.

abilities.name: Bitter Chill
abilities.desc: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a 350 unit radius.

options: Ice Shards slow by 50% and deal 110 DPS

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.desc: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
notes: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it. Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
Arcane Bolt cannot be disjointed.
abilities.lore: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.
abilities.shard: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, 2 bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: Concussive Shot
abilities.desc: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range. Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
notes: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
Damages creeps around the impact area.
Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
abilities.lore: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.
abilities.scepter: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within 500 range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: Ancient Seal
abilities.desc: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
notes: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
abilities.lore: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.
abilities.scepter: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within 500 range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: Shield of the Scion
abilities.desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
abilities.lore: The court mages of Skywrath may only deploy their magic in defense of the kingdom and the throne.

abilities.name: Mystic Flare
abilities.desc: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over 2 seconds.
notes: Mystic Flare only affects Heroes. Mystic Flare does not damage creep heroes.
Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.
abilities.lore: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.
abilities.scepter: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: Mist Coil
abilities.desc: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
notes: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.
abilities.lore: A mysterious vapor from the Font of Avernus now infuses the breath of Abaddon, who releases it at will.

abilities.name: Aphotic Shield
abilities.desc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.
abilities.lore: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.
abilities.shard: 75% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Curse of Avernus
abilities.desc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.
abilities.lore: While the baptized draw strength from the Font, the gifts of Avernus are debilitating to the uninitiated.

abilities.name: Withering Mist
abilities.desc: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 29.5% if they are below 40% HP.

abilities.name: Borrowed Time
abilities.desc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below 400.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced. The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.
abilities.lore: The most unnatural of all the gifts of the Font of Avernus, this power defies mortal understanding. What should hurt, instead heals; and what should kill gives strength anew.
abilities.scepter: Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than 550 damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.

options: +65 Curse of Avernus Attack Speed Bonus

abilities.name: Echo Stomp
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations. The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
notes: If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.
abilities.lore: The force of creation still echoes in the stomp of the Titan.
abilities.shard: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.

abilities.name: Astral Spirit
abilities.desc:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through. When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
abilities.lore: Like the four fundamentals, Elder Titan exists across all planes at once and can draw other aspects of himself to assist in times of need.
abilities.scepter: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain 50% magic resistance for 2 seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.

abilities.name: Natural Order
abilities.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
notes: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.
abilities.lore: As it was at the beginning, Elder Titan makes it so again.
abilities.shard: Every s that enemy heroes stay under the effect of Natural Order, their armor is reduced by , and magic resistance is reduced by %. Stacks up to times.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.desc: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.
notes: Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.

abilities.name: Earth Splitter
abilities.desc: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
abilities.lore: That which he created, the titan tears asunder.

options: +2.5% Astral Spirit Bonus Move Speed Per Hero
20% of Bonus Movement Speed as Attack Speed
+30 Astral Spirit Bonus Damage per Hero

abilities.name: Overwhelming Odds
abilities.desc: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a 100% impact slow for 0.3s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
abilities.lore: The archers of Stonehall are ready at Tresdin's command.
abilities.shard: Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.

abilities.name: Press The Attack
abilities.desc:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.lore: The rallying horn of the Bronze Legion is able to inspire any heart.
abilities.scepter: Increases movement speed and becomes an 500 area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.

abilities.name: Moment of Courage
abilities.desc: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
notes: The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.
abilities.lore: Tresdin knows that an enemy's most vulnerable moment often follows their fiercest stroke.

abilities.name: Outfight Them!
abilities.desc: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value. This bonus stacks independently.

abilities.name: Duel
abilities.desc: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
notes: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
abilities.lore: To face a soldier of Stonehall in single combat is a challenge few can resist.
abilities.scepter: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.

options: -1 Moment of Courage Attacks To Trigger
Duel Advances Cooldown by 30s On Victory

abilities.name: Searing Chains
abilities.desc: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
notes: Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.
abilities.lore: Xin's harshest lessons often employed the use of red-hot chains.

abilities.name: Sleight of Fist
abilities.desc: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location. Deals bonus damage to heroes.
notes: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every 0.25 seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.
abilities.lore: The studied warrior must whip and weave through its enemies, burning each without pause.

abilities.name: Flame Guard
abilities.desc: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
notes: Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
The damage lingers for an additional 0.5 seconds after application.
abilities.lore: An enemy should never be allowed to approach without difficulty.

abilities.name: Activate Fire Remnant
abilities.desc: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.
abilities.lore: With blazing speed does a spirit fly!

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.desc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
notes: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.
abilities.shard: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.

abilities.name: Fire Remnant
abilities.desc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at 250% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant. Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
notes: Starts with 3 charges (maximum).
abilities.lore: By the spirit's power are Xin's teachings spread anew.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.
abilities.shard: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.

abilities.name: Boulder Smash
abilities.desc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a 200 radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits. If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.
abilities.lore: It is with the power of a mountain that Earth Spirit strikes his enemies.

abilities.name: Rolling Boulder
abilities.desc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
notes: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of 160.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.
abilities.lore: Calling upon his connection to the land, the Earth Spirit draws loose stone to him, which forms a protective ball that he can use to roll short distances.

abilities.name: Geomagnetic Grip
abilities.desc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
notes: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.
abilities.lore: Like calls to like. Even the minerals found in the blood and bones of living beings are not immune to the call of the Earth Spirit.
abilities.shard: Decreases cooldown to 3s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.

abilities.name: Stone Remnant
abilities.desc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 3% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5% bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
abilities.lore: Earth Spirit calls forth a remnant of his stone army, long buried with him in the dark embrace of the Earth.

abilities.name: Enchant Remnant
abilities.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies.
Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
notes: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.
abilities.lore: Kaolin uses the elemental power of the Earth to temporarily petrify living beings, so that they might be conscripted into his stone funerary army.

abilities.name: Magnetize
abilities.desc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.
abilities.lore: At the Earth Spirit's call, the minerals in the blood and bones of his enemies rebel against the bodies they find themselves in.

abilities.name: Reflection
abilities.desc: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
notes: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
Reflections can only attack their source.
abilities.lore: In the fractal prison of Foulfell, Terrorblade learned the truth of this old tale: you are your own worst enemy. Now it is a lesson he teaches others.

abilities.name: Conjure Image
abilities.desc: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
notes: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.
abilities.lore: There's only one thing more dangerous than facing Terrorblade. Facing MORE Terrorblades!

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.desc: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within 1200 range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
notes: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.
abilities.lore: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control. Meet Terrorblade's own worst self.

abilities.name: Demon Zeal
abilities.desc: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
abilities.lore: Fear is fueled by confusion when Terrorblade's enemies see that the first cut he makes is one to embolden himself.

abilities.name: Terror Wave
abilities.desc: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
abilities.lore: A shockwave of power strong enough to break the walls of Foulfell itself.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.desc: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
notes: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.
abilities.lore: You didn't need that life, did you? The demon marauder steals that which you hold most dear.

abilities.name: Dark Unity
abilities.desc: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.
notes: Reflection Illusions are also affected.

abilities.name: Icarus Dive
abilities.desc: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
notes: Icarus Dive has a 2 second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.
abilities.lore: Though no stranger to travelling the cosmic void, soaring within an atmosphere offers unique pleasures.

abilities.name: Fire Spirits
abilities.desc: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
notes: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.
abilities.lore: The ever-collapsing core of Phoenix often emits short-lived bursts of conscious light.
abilities.shard: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.

abilities.name: Sun Ray
abilities.desc: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
notes: Sun Ray has a width of 130 units, and a length of 1200 units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.
abilities.lore: The vent through which such stellar energy flows is mere atoms wide.
abilities.shard: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.

abilities.name: Dying Light
abilities.desc: Phoenix deals 3.5% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a 400 radius every second.
notes: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.desc:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After 6 seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.lore: The solar crucible of a Supernova may be fatal, yet from its flames arise new beacons to wander infinity.
abilities.scepter: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.

options: +1% Dying Light Missing Health as Damage

abilities.name: Fortune's End
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Affects invulnerable units.
abilities.lore: The astral orb crackles with power while raw energy lances out, temporarily disrupting an enemy's connection to their own body.

abilities.name: Fate's Edict
abilities.desc: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them 100% magic damage resistance.
abilities.lore: An unbreakable prophecy resounds: a chosen ally shall briefly suffer no magics. Other kinds of suffering however...

abilities.name: Purifying Flames
abilities.desc: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
notes: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.
abilities.lore: Like a hall of mirrors might amplify the light of a single candle, the shattered walls of the universe can transform the light of prophecy into a burning torch.

abilities.name: Rain of Destiny
abilities.desc: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.
abilities.lore: Through mixture of the astral and the atmospheric, Nerif bends a single reality into paradoxical alignment.

abilities.name: False Promise
abilities.desc:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.
abilities.lore: Foes and false prophets oft make lies of men's fates.

abilities.name: Prognosticate
abilities.desc: Oracle will predict and announce to allies, where the next power rune will spawn (top or bottom) as well as Roshan's exact respawn time.

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.desc: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for 3 seconds.
abilities.lore: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.

abilities.name: Reactive Tazer
abilities.desc:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
abilities.lore: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.

abilities.name: Blast Off!
abilities.desc: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
notes: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.
This ability destroys trees.
abilities.lore: Where we going?

abilities.name: M.A.D.
abilities.desc:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after 1.5s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.
abilities.shard: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant an M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.

abilities.name: Minefield Sign
abilities.desc:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.
abilities.lore: Watch your step!

abilities.name: Proximity Mines
abilities.desc: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active 500 AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for 1 seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within 150 radius and decreases down to 50% on the edge. Deals 30% damage to buildings.
notes: Cannot be placed within 350 AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
abilities.lore: The bane of Toterin!

options: +25% Reactive Tazer Buff and Disarm Duration

abilities.name: Arctic Burn
abilities.desc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of 4 / 6 / 8 / 10% of their current health each second.
notes: This ability does not affect Roshan.
Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to 0.1.
The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.
abilities.lore: The same organ where some dragons stoke their inner flame is, in Auroth, a crucible of unimaginable cold. From deep within her frosty gullet, an exhalation sends enemies into burning agony.
abilities.scepter: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.

abilities.name: Splinter Blast
abilities.desc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a 500 base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by 27 / 30 / 33 / 36%.
notes: The primary projectile moves at 1200 movement speed.
The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.
abilities.lore: Produced slowly by specialized vesicles in her frozen gullet, Winter Wyvern blast shards of ice at her enemies.

abilities.name: Cold Embrace
abilities.desc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
abilities.lore: From winter's heart comes a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.
abilities.shard: Reduces cooldown by 4 seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.

abilities.name: Eldwurm's Edda
abilities.desc: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by 25% of its current value at the time of consumption.

abilities.name: Winter's Curse
abilities.desc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
notes: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.
abilities.lore: The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.

options: +15 Cold Embrace Base Heal Per Second

abilities.name: Flux
abilities.desc: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
abilities.lore: An infinitesimal fraction of the power which imprisoned the Ancients.
abilities.scepter: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.

abilities.name: Magnetic Field
abilities.desc: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
abilities.lore: Time and space are of little consequence to one as old as Zet.

abilities.name: Spark Wraith
abilities.desc: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
notes: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.
abilities.lore: Lesser fragments of Zet's original self.

abilities.name: Runic Infusion
abilities.desc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +1.5 all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

abilities.name: Tempest Double
abilities.desc:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
notes: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.
abilities.lore: Warped by the power of its peers, Arc Warden becomes what it despises most: disharmony.
abilities.shard:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for 12s when created.

Does not trigger Runic Infusion.

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.desc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
abilities.lore: The flames of conquest blaze forth from the darkest depths of the abyss.
abilities.shard: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around. The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

abilities.name: Pit of Malice
abilities.desc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every 3.6 seconds.
abilities.lore: Twisting into the seams of reality itself, Vrogros' manifest hatred paralyzes those who defy his will.

abilities.name: Atrophy Aura
abilities.desc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
notes: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
abilities.lore: To merely stand in the presence of the Underlord is to feel the conviction of battle sapped from one's soul.

abilities.name: Invading Force
abilities.desc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

abilities.name: Fiend's Gate
abilities.desc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.
notes: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain
abilities.lore: They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.
abilities.scepter: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.

options: 160 DPS in 700 Radius Around Fiend's Gate

abilities.name: Boundless Strike
abilities.desc: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
abilities.lore: The legendary Jingu Bang grows to match its master's will, ensuring no enemy can escape the Monkey King's reach.
abilities.shard: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with 35% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.

abilities.name: Tree Dance
abilities.desc: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for 3s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
notes: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
abilities.lore: Sun Wukong dances nimbly along the treetop canopy, always just out of arm's reach.

abilities.name: Jingu Mastery
abilities.desc: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
notes: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
abilities.lore: Always sensitive to the moods of its master, the Jingu Bang radiates power when Sun Wukong's combat fervor is on full display.

abilities.name: Mischief
abilities.desc: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for 0.1 seconds upon transforming.
abilities.lore: Watch out for that tree.

abilities.name: Wukong's Command
abilities.desc:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of 1.1s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
notes: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.
abilities.lore: Monkey King rips out a tuft of fur to blow at his enemies, charging each strand to transform into a copy of himself.
abilities.scepter: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.

abilities.name: Changing of the Guard
abilities.desc: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a 1.5s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells

abilities.name: Swashbuckle
abilities.desc:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
notes: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.
abilities.lore: The Pangolier's blade is even nimbler than his tongue.

abilities.name: Shield Crash
abilities.desc:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
abilities.lore: Only in the midst of his enemies does the Pangolier truly thrive.
abilities.scepter: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals 75% damage.

abilities.name: Lucky Shot
abilities.desc: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.
abilities.lore: The Pangolier's blade is guided more often by whim than reason.

abilities.name: Roll Up
abilities.desc: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, 80% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
abilities.lore: It requires deft tailwork and immense balance to defy momentum in the heart of battle.

abilities.name: Rolling Thunder
abilities.desc:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with 80% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land.

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier 1s to reach full roll speed.
abilities.lore: Where his ancestors sought only refuge, the Pangolier saw opportunity...

abilities.name: Fortune Favors the Bold
abilities.desc: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
notes: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.

abilities.name: Bramble Maze
abilities.desc: Dark Willow creates a 500 AoE maze of 8 brambles that grow in the target area after 0.3 seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts 12 seconds.
notes: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.
abilities.lore: The fae realm exists all around you, merely waiting to draw you in...

abilities.name: Shadow Realm
abilities.desc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable. Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3 seconds.
notes: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
abilities.lore: What you can't see will most definitely hurt you.
abilities.scepter: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.

abilities.name: Cursed Crown
abilities.desc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
abilities.lore: Didn't anyone ever tell you? Never strike a deal with a fairy...
abilities.shard: Cursed Crown creates 4 brambles in a 175 radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Bedlam
abilities.desc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies. Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
abilities.lore: You'll have to excuse my friend Jex. He's really into murder.

abilities.name: Pixie Dust
abilities.desc: Dark Willow gains 20% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to 100% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

abilities.name: Terrorize
abilities.desc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
notes: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.
abilities.lore: You think you know the first thing about fear? Jex'll show you what that word truly means...

abilities.name: Stroke of Fate
abilities.desc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
abilities.lore: The corruptive force of Grimstroke's ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.

abilities.name: Phantom's Embrace
abilities.desc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
notes: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.
abilities.lore: Grimstroke holds no sorrow for the downfall of his people. Only for Yaovhi, she who was most dear to him, does he feel even a semblance of longing.

abilities.name: Ink Swell
abilities.desc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After 3 seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
abilities.lore: Now that the rise of the ink tide no longer threatens to overwhelm Grimstroke, its tendrils of power are never far from his hand.
abilities.shard:
Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal 40% more damage and heal the target for 40% of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Dark Portrait
abilities.desc: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has 90% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
abilities.lore: No dark creation is beyond the skill of the master's hand.

abilities.name: Soulbind
abilities.desc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
notes: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.
abilities.lore: The Ascended were chosen sons of Ashkavor, granted immense power by the bonds forged between their own souls and those they were charged with protecting. In the years that followed the ruination of his kin, Grimstroke discovered much more sinister applications for the binding rituals...

abilities.name: Ink Trail
abilities.desc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for 4s.
notes: Provides vision over affected heroes.
Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.

options: +70% Stroke of Fate Speed and Travel Range

abilities.name: Spear of Mars
abilities.desc: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
notes: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
abilities.lore: The legendary Spear of Mars still glows with the heat of the forge god's fires.
abilities.shard: Spear of Mars impales up to 1 heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.

abilities.name: God's Rebuke
abilities.desc: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
notes: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.
abilities.lore: There isn't a warrior alive who can stand unmoved by the sting of Mars' rebuke.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.desc:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

 Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
notes: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.
abilities.lore: Only the very foolish dare to fight fair with the god of war.
abilities.scepter: Creates invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.

abilities.name: Dauntless
abilities.desc: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in 900 radius.

abilities.name: Arena Of Blood
abilities.desc: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
abilities.lore: The long-dead members of the Ash Legion, assembled from the finest warriors to ever test the might of Mars, still revel in the thrill of combat, gladly beholden to the hand that fell them for as long as he so commands.
abilities.scepter: Lowers cooldown by s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore 35% of their max health and mana and get a 35% attack damage buff for 20s. This effect stacks.

options: Arena Of Blood Grants Team +180 HP Regen

abilities.name: Aether Remnant
abilities.desc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
abilities.lore: Inai exists far beyond the scope of a single point in space and time.
abilities.shard: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant. The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing 50% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.

abilities.name: Dissimilate
abilities.desc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
abilities.lore: Inai much prefers to observe our plane free from the confines of corporeal form.

abilities.name: Resonant Pulse
abilities.desc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
abilities.lore: Inai never hesitates to shroud himself in the essence of his true self when forced to interact with the mortal plane.
abilities.scepter: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain 2 charges.

abilities.name: Intrinsic Edge
abilities.desc: Void Spirit gains 15% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and 30% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

abilities.name: Astral Step
abilities.desc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.
notes: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.
abilities.lore: A small step for Inai creates great devastation on the mortal plane.

abilities.name: Scatterblast
abilities.desc: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by 25% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by 50% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
abilities.lore: A favorite from her collection, Beadie crafted Ol' Rackatee as her first line of defense when she ventured into the Outlands.

abilities.name: Firesnap Cookie
abilities.desc: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
notes: The cookie projectile has a speed of 1200.
abilities.lore: With the help of a secret mixture that pairs Beadie's baking skills with her passion for black powder, these battle biscuits pack a punch.
abilities.shard: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does 40% impact damage to the landing destination.

abilities.name: Lil' Shredder
abilities.desc: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire 5 attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
notes: Sets base attack time to 1s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.
abilities.lore: Beadie constantly tinkers with a design she first dreamed up plotting an exodus from her old gang.

abilities.name: Gobble Up
abilities.desc: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to 0 seconds.
notes: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.
abilities.lore: SHLORP!

abilities.name: Spit Out
abilities.desc: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
abilities.lore: SPITTOOO!

abilities.name: Mortimer Kisses
abilities.desc: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
notes: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of 0.8 and maximum travel time of 2.
abilities.lore: Little did Beadie know when she adopted Mortimer, dragon toads--which aren't even toads at all--share more than just a name with their distant draconic cousins.

abilities.name: Boomstick
abilities.desc: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Acorn Shot
abilities.desc:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit. The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets. The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
notes: The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.
abilities.lore: Though she'll make do with almost anything, Oak and Ironwood acorns make the most effective projectiles -- and the bulk of Hoodwink's stash.

abilities.name: Bushwhack
abilities.desc: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area. Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
notes: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.
abilities.lore: Hoodwink favors Ironwood groves for ambushes, but the wary step carefully in all areas of the mistwoods.

abilities.name: Scurry
abilities.desc: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by 2.
abilities.lore: There's not a nook or cranny in the Wood Tomo'kan out of reach of Hoodwink's paws.

abilities.name: Decoy
abilities.desc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
abilities.lore: The best traps trigger whether you touch them or not.

abilities.name: Hunter's Boomerang
abilities.desc: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink. The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
abilities.lore: A precious last vestige of Hoodwink's childhood, converted into deadly distraction.

abilities.name: Sharpshooter
abilities.desc:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero. The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after 3 seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after 5 seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of 350 from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
abilities.lore: While her first arbalest was a chance discovery, Hoodwink now takes great care in carving and caring for her own -- of course with some necessary components pilfered or otherwise cleverly procured.
abilities.scepter: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.

abilities.name: Mistwoods Wayfarer
abilities.desc: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
notes: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.

abilities.name: Starbreaker
abilities.desc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
notes: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of 215 for the duration of the ability and takes a brief 0.2s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by -100% for 0.12s.
abilities.lore: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.
abilities.shard: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with 50% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by 35% down to a minimum of 215.

abilities.name: Celestial Hammer
abilities.desc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
notes: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
abilities.lore: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.

abilities.name: Luminosity
abilities.desc: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within 650 units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for 50% of the amount.
notes: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
abilities.lore: Diminished in power without access to the Children's replenishing light, Valora can still recharge herself and her allies by creating order from the chaos which resides within each fight.
abilities.scepter: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.

abilities.name: Break of Dawn
abilities.desc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
abilities.scepter: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

abilities.name: Solar Guardian
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within 350 units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for 6s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
notes: Pulse interval is 0.5s.
Total flight duration is 1.7 seconds of channel time + 0.8 of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
abilities.lore: Only in defense of an ally will Valora relent to call upon the last reserves of her old powers that still allow cosmic flight.
abilities.scepter: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for 2s after landing.

options: Celestial Hammer Trail Grants Movement Speed to Allies

abilities.name: Dispose
abilities.desc: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
abilities.lore: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.

abilities.name: Rebound
abilities.desc:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives 25% bonus movement speed for 4s.
notes: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.
abilities.lore: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.
abilities.shard: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.

abilities.name: Bodyguard
abilities.desc:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with 75% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, 30% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
notes: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a 40% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
abilities.lore: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.

abilities.name: Special Delivery
abilities.desc:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.
notes: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of 1 second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.
abilities.lore: Professional courtesy, from one courier to another.

abilities.name: Unleash
abilities.desc:
